attributes.description: The cost performance efficiency required on remaining work to meet the budget at completion (BAC) or estimate at completion (EAC). Calculated as (BAC minus BCWP) divided by (BAC minus ACWP). Indicates future cost efficiency needed.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this EVM period record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); ISO 9001 Record Control

attributes.name: vac
attributes.description: The projected cost variance at project completion, calculated as BAC minus EAC. A positive value indicates projected under-budget completion; negative indicates projected cost overrun. Critical for P&L forecasting and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: ANSI/EIA-748 VAC; PMI PMBOK EVM; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting

attributes.name: verifying_engineer
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the engineer or quantity surveyor who independently verified and certified the physical percent complete measurement for this period record. Required for progress payment certification.
attributes.references: FIDIC Contract Administration; ISO 9001 QA/QC; Procore Field Management

products.name: progress_measurement
products.description: Periodic physical progress measurement record at WBS element or activity level, capturing percent complete, earned quantity, installed quantity, measurement method (weighted steps, milestone, units complete), measurement date, reporting period, and verifying engineer. Feeds EVM calculations and progress billing. Sourced from HCSS HeavyJob production tracking and Procore field management.
products.reference: Progress Measurement — Procore / HCSS HeavyJob Production Tracking

attributes.name: progress_measurement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each periodic physical progress measurement record. Primary key for the progress_measurement data product in the project domain Silver layer.
attributes.references: PMO Governance Standard; Oracle Primavera P6

attributes.name: activity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific schedule activity within the WBS element being measured. Corresponds to the Primavera P6 activity object used in CPM (Critical Path Method) scheduling.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6; HCSS HeavyJob Production Tracking

attributes.name: client_verifier_contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.contact. Business justification: Client verification of progress claims is a named billing/payment process in construction — a client representative must sign off on measured quantities before payment certificates are issued. The pla

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent construction project against which this progress measurement is recorded. Links to the project master entity.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems

attributes.name: cost_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.cost_account. Business justification: Physical progress measurements are linked to cost accounts for earned value calculation at the control account level. Adding cost_account_id to progress_measurement enables direct linkage between fiel

attributes.name: evm_period_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.evm_period_record. Business justification: Progress measurements are the source data that feeds EVM period records. Linking progress_measurement to evm_period_record establishes the traceability chain from individual physical progress observat

attributes.name: project_baseline_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_baseline. Business justification: Physical progress measurements must reference the approved baseline to compute schedule variance and earned value correctly. Adding project_baseline_id to progress_measurement links each measurement r

attributes.name: billing_period_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier of the progress billing certificate or payment application period to which this measurement contributes (e.g., IPC-007, PA-2024-03). Links measurement data to the contract administration billing cycle.
attributes.references: FIDIC Contract Conditions; Procore; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems

attributes.name: budget_at_completion
attributes.description: Total approved budget for this WBS element or activity at the time of measurement. Denominator for earned value calculation and basis for EVM (Earned Value Management) performance indices.
attributes.references: ANSI/EIA-748 EVM Standard; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems

attributes.name: budgeted_quantity
attributes.description: Total planned quantity of work for this WBS element or activity as defined in the approved BOQ (Bill of Quantities) or project baseline. Denominator for units-complete percent complete calculation.
attributes.references: BOQ (Bill of Quantities) Standard; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems

attributes.name: cost_variance
attributes.description: Difference between earned value and actual cost (EV minus AC) for this WBS element as of the measurement date. Negative value indicates cost overrun. Stored as a raw EVM (Earned Value Management) field, not a derived KPI.

attributes.name: cpi
attributes.description: Ratio of earned value to actual cost (EV divided by AC) for this WBS element at the measurement date. CPI (Cost Performance Index) greater than 1.0 indicates cost efficiency; less than 1.0 indicates overrun. Stored at measurement grain for trend analysis.
attributes.references: ANSI/EIA-748 EVM Standard; PMI PMBOK; Oracle Primavera P6

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this progress measurement record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides audit trail for data governance and lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to earned_value, planned_value, and budget_at_completion monetary fields (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency EPC (Engineering Procurement Construction) projects.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: discipline
attributes.description: Engineering or construction discipline to which this WBS element or activity belongs (e.g., Civil, Structural, MEP (Mechanical Electrical Plumbing), Piping, Electrical, Instrumentation). Used for discipline-level progress roll-up reporting.

attributes.name: earned_value
attributes.description: Budgeted cost of work performed (BCWP) for this WBS element or activity as of the measurement date, calculated as percent_complete multiplied by the budget at completion. Core EVM (Earned Value Management) metric.
attributes.references: ANSI/EIA-748 EVM Standard; PMI PMBOK; Oracle Primavera P6

attributes.name: installed_quantity
attributes.description: Cumulative physical quantity of work installed or completed to date as of the measurement date (e.g., cubic metres of concrete poured, linear metres of pipe laid, tonnes of steel erected). Used in units-complete measurement method.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob Production Tracking; BOQ (Bill of Quantities) Standard

attributes.name: is_billing_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this approved progress measurement qualifies for inclusion in a progress billing certificate or payment application (True/False). Controlled by measurement_status and contract billing terms.
attributes.references: FIDIC Contract Conditions; Procore; SAP S/4HANA AP/AR

attributes.name: is_milestone
attributes.description: Indicates whether this progress measurement corresponds to a contractual or project milestone event (True) rather than a continuous activity (False). Milestone measurements trigger specific billing and reporting actions.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6; FIDIC Contract Conditions

attributes.name: measurement_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which the physical progress measurement was taken in the field. This is the principal real-world event date, distinct from the reporting period end date or record creation timestamp.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob Production Tracking; Oracle Primavera P6

attributes.name: measurement_method
attributes.description: The technique used to quantify physical progress for this WBS element or activity. Weighted steps assigns weight to discrete sub-tasks; milestone marks binary completion; units complete counts installed quantities. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: weighted_steps|milestone|units_complete|percent_complete|level_of_effort|physical_observation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ANSI/EIA-748 EVM Standard; Oracle Primavera P6; HCSS HeavyJob

attributes.name: measurement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this measurement record, typically formatted as a sequential reference number (e.g., PM-2024-00123). Used in progress billing certificates and PMO reporting.

attributes.name: measurement_source
attributes.description: Originating operational system from which this progress measurement was sourced. Supports data lineage traceability across HCSS HeavyJob production tracking, Procore field management, and Oracle Primavera P6.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob; Procore; Oracle Primavera P6; SAP S/4HANA PS

attributes.name: measurement_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle state of the progress measurement record, from initial field capture through engineer verification to client approval. Controls eligibility for progress billing.

attributes.name: measurement_type
attributes.description: Classifies whether this measurement record captures physical progress only, financial progress (cost-based), or a combined physical and financial assessment. Determines which EVM fields are populated.
attributes.references: ANSI/EIA-748 EVM Standard; PMO Governance Standard

attributes.name: ncr_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of any associated NCR (Non-Conformance Report) that may affect the validity or acceptance of this progress measurement. A populated value indicates rework or quality hold may impact claimed progress.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; Procore QA/QC

attributes.name: percent_complete
attributes.description: Physical percent complete of the WBS element or activity as measured at the measurement date, expressed as a value between 0.00 and 100.00. This is the primary quantitative progress fact used in EVM (Earned Value Management) calculations.
attributes.references: ANSI/EIA-748 EVM Standard; Oracle Primavera P6; HCSS HeavyJob

attributes.name: period_installed_quantity
attributes.description: Physical quantity of work installed or completed during the current reporting period only (incremental, not cumulative). Feeds period progress billing and production rate analysis in HCSS HeavyJob.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob Production Tracking; Procore Field Management

attributes.name: planned_percent_complete
attributes.description: Baseline-scheduled percent complete for this WBS element or activity as of the measurement date, derived from the approved project baseline in Primavera P6. Used to compute SPI (Schedule Performance Index) variance.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6; ANSI/EIA-748 EVM Standard

attributes.name: planned_value
attributes.description: Budgeted cost of work scheduled (BCWS) for this WBS element or activity as of the measurement date, derived from the approved baseline schedule. Core EVM (Earned Value Management) metric used to compute SPI (Schedule Performance Index).
attributes.references: ANSI/EIA-748 EVM Standard; PMI PMBOK; Oracle Primavera P6

attributes.name: previous_percent_complete
attributes.description: Physical percent complete recorded in the immediately preceding reporting period. Enables period-over-period progress increment calculation and trend analysis without requiring a self-join.
attributes.references: ANSI/EIA-748 EVM Standard; Oracle Primavera P6

attributes.name: quantity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure applicable to installed_quantity, period_installed_quantity, and budgeted_quantity fields (e.g., m3, LM, tonne, EA, m2, LS). Aligns with BOQ (Bill of Quantities) unit conventions.
attributes.references: BOQ (Bill of Quantities) Standard; ISO 80000 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for the field engineer or verifier to record observations, constraints, or qualifications affecting this progress measurement (e.g., weather delays, access restrictions, partial completion notes).

attributes.name: reporting_period_code
attributes.description: Reference to the defined reporting period (weekly, monthly, or milestone-based) within which this progress measurement falls. Used for period-over-period EVM (Earned Value Management) analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; EVM Standard ANSI/EIA-748

attributes.name: reporting_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the reporting period to which this progress measurement belongs. Defines the data cut-off for period progress billing and EVM (Earned Value Management) calculations.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6; ANSI/EIA-748 EVM Standard

attributes.name: reporting_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the reporting period to which this progress measurement belongs. Used to align measurements with EVM (Earned Value Management) data cut-off cycles.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6; ANSI/EIA-748 EVM Standard

attributes.name: schedule_variance
attributes.description: Difference between earned value and planned value (EV minus PV) for this WBS element as of the measurement date. Negative value indicates schedule delay. Stored as a raw EVM (Earned Value Management) field, not a derived KPI.

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: Native record identifier from the originating operational system (HCSS HeavyJob cost code entry ID, Procore production entry ID, or Primavera P6 activity ID string). Enables traceability back to the system of record.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob; Procore; Oracle Primavera P6

attributes.name: spi
attributes.description: Ratio of earned value to planned value (EV divided by PV) for this WBS element at the measurement date. SPI (Schedule Performance Index) greater than 1.0 indicates ahead of schedule; less than 1.0 indicates behind schedule.
attributes.references: ANSI/EIA-748 EVM Standard; PMI PMBOK; Oracle Primavera P6

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this progress measurement record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail in the Databricks Silver layer.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the verifying engineer formally approved and signed off this progress measurement record. Distinct from measurement_date (when field observation occurred) and created_timestamp (when record was entered).

attributes.name: work_area
attributes.description: Physical site area, zone, or work front where the measured work is being performed (e.g., Zone A, Block 3, Pier 7). Aligns with site work front definitions used in HCSS HeavyJob and Procore daily logs.

products.name: project_change_order

Tracks CO number, description, change type (scope addition, scope reduction, design change, unforeseen condition), cost impact, schedule impact (EOT — Extension of Time), originator, approval status, approval date, and contract reference. SSOT for all approved project changes. Sourced from Procore Change Orders module.

attributes.name: project_change_order_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the change order record in the lakehouse Silver layer. Primary key for the project_change_order data product.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the prime contract or subcontract against which this change order is issued. Establishes the contractual basis for the CO.

attributes.name: approving_contact_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to bid.bid_boq_line. Business justification: Change orders in construction modify specific BOQ line items — scope change management requires tracing which BOQ line is being varied. This link supports variation order valuation, BOQ reconciliation

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent project to which this change order belongs. Links the CO to the project master record.

attributes.name: contract_change_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.contract_change_order. Business justification: Required for the Change Order Management process: each project change order must reference the contract change order that amends the agreement, enabling cost/schedule impact tracking.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.phase. Business justification: Change orders are raised within a specific project phase and their cost/schedule impacts are attributed to that phase. Adding phase_id to project_change_order enables phase-level change order analysis

attributes.name: scope_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.contract_scope. Business justification: Change orders in construction modify a specific contract scope section. Linking project_change_order to contract_scope enables scope-level change order tracking, scope growth analysis, and budget impa

attributes.name: technical_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.technical_specification. Linking CO to the triggering technical specification enables specification-driven ch

attributes.name: aconex_mail_ref
attributes.description: Aconex correspondence or transmittal reference number for the formal change order submission and approval correspondence. Provides document management traceability.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the change order received final approval from the authorised signatory (client, owner, or engineer). Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle state of the change order. Tracks progression from initial draft through client or owner approval. Only approved COs update the project baseline.

attributes.name: budget_line_item_ref
attributes.description: Reference to the project budget line item or BOQ (Bill of Quantities) item that this change order modifies. Enables budget impact tracking at line-item level.

attributes.name: change_type

attributes.name: cost_impact_currency

attributes.name: description

attributes.name: direct_cost_amount

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: eot_granted_days

attributes.name: is_disputed

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date

attributes.name: mitigation_response_type
attributes.description: Standard risk response strategy type applied to this risk: avoid (eliminate the risk), transfer (shift to another party via contract/insurance), mitigate (reduce probability/impact), accept (acknowledge and monitor), exploit (maximise opportunity), or enhance (increase opportunity probability/impact).
attributes.references: ISO 31000 Risk Management; PMBOK 6th Edition Risk Management; FIDIC Clause 17

attributes.name: mitigation_strategy
attributes.description: Detailed description of the planned or implemented actions to reduce the probability or impact of the risk event. Includes engineering controls, contractual protections, procurement strategies, and HSE measures.
attributes.references: ISO 31000 Risk Management; PMO Governance Framework; FIDIC Clause 17

attributes.name: probability_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative probability rating of the risk event occurring, using the standard five-point PMO scale. Complements the quantitative probability score for risk matrix visualisation and executive reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 31000 Risk Management; PMO Governance Framework

attributes.name: probability_score
attributes.description: Quantitative probability of the risk event occurring, expressed as a decimal between 0.0000 and 1.0000 (e.g., 0.3500 = 35%). Used in risk scoring calculations and Monte Carlo simulation inputs for contingency management.
attributes.references: ISO 31000 Risk Management; PMBOK Risk Management; PMO Governance Framework

attributes.name: quality_impact_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative rating of the potential quality impact if the risk event is realized. Supports QA/QC risk assessment and Non-Conformance Report (NCR) prevention planning.
attributes.references: ISO 31000 Risk Management; ISO 9001 Quality Management; PMO Governance Framework

attributes.name: regulatory_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this risk involves a regulatory or permitting dimension (e.g., EPA environmental permits, OSHA compliance, IBC building code, LEED certification requirements). Triggers regulatory compliance review.
attributes.references: OSHA Regulations; EPA Regulations; IBC International Building Code; ISO 14001

attributes.name: residual_probability_score
attributes.description: Quantitative probability of the risk event occurring after mitigation actions have been applied, expressed as a decimal between 0.0000 and 1.0000. Measures the effectiveness of the risk response strategy.
attributes.references: ISO 31000 Risk Management; PMO Governance Framework

attributes.name: residual_risk_score
attributes.description: Composite risk score remaining after mitigation actions have been applied. Compared against the pre-mitigation risk score to demonstrate risk reduction effectiveness and support PMO governance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 31000 Risk Management; PMO Governance Framework

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal review of this risk entry by the risk owner and PMO. Ensures risks are regularly reassessed and not left stale in the register.
attributes.references: ISO 31000 Risk Management; PMO Governance Framework

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: Classification of the risk into a standard PMO risk category: technical (design, engineering, construction method), commercial (cost, contract, financial), schedule (programme, critical path), hse (Health Safety and Environment), regulatory (permits, compliance), or force_majeure (natural events, geopolitical). Drives risk reporting by category.
attributes.references: ISO 31000 Risk Management; FIDIC Clause 17; PMO Governance Framework; ISO 45001

attributes.name: risk_code

attributes.references: PMO Governance Framework; Oracle Primavera P6 Risk Module; Procore Risk Register

attributes.name: risk_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the risk or opportunity event, its cause, and potential consequence. Captures the full context required for risk assessment and mitigation planning.
attributes.references: ISO 31000 Risk Management; FIDIC Clause 17 Risk Allocation

attributes.name: risk_proximity
attributes.description: Indicates the time horizon within which the risk event is expected to occur: immediate (within 30 days), near_term (30–90 days), medium_term (90–180 days), or long_term (beyond 180 days). Supports prioritisation of risk response actions.
attributes.references: ISO 31000 Risk Management; PMO Governance Framework; Oracle Primavera P6

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Composite risk score calculated as the product of probability and impact ratings, typically on a 1–25 scale (5x5 risk matrix). Used to prioritise risks in the PMO risk register and determine escalation thresholds.
attributes.references: ISO 31000 Risk Management; PMO Governance Framework

attributes.name: risk_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the risk register entry: open (active, being monitored), mitigated (response actions applied), closed (no longer applicable), realized (risk event has occurred), or transferred (risk transferred to another party via contract/insurance). LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this entity.
attributes.references: ISO 31000 Risk Management; PMO Governance Framework; FIDIC Clause 17

attributes.name: risk_title
attributes.description: Short, human-readable title summarising the risk or opportunity. Used as the primary display label in PMO dashboards, risk reports, and executive summaries. IDENTITY_LABEL for this entity.
attributes.references: ISO 31000 Risk Management; PMO Governance Framework

attributes.name: risk_trigger

attributes.references: ISO 31000 Risk Management; PMBOK Risk Management; PMO Governance Framework

attributes.name: risk_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the register entry represents a threat (negative impact) or an opportunity (positive impact) to the project. Supports balanced risk and opportunity management per PMO governance.
attributes.references: ISO 31000 Risk Management; PMBOK 6th Edition Risk Management

attributes.name: schedule_impact_days

attributes.name: schedule_impact_rating

attributes.references: ISO 31000 Risk Management; PMO Governance Framework; Oracle Primavera P6

attributes.name: actual_cost_to_date
attributes.description: Total actual cost incurred on the project or WBS element from inception through the reporting period data date. Represents the Actual Cost of Work Performed (ACWP) in EVM terminology. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA cost postings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; PMI Earned Value Management Standard; IFRS 15

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this forecast record was formally approved by the authorized PMO or project controls authority for inclusion in P&L reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; PMO Governance Framework

attributes.name: bac_cost
attributes.description: The approved Budget at Completion (BAC) for the project or WBS element as of the reporting period, representing the total authorized budget. Used as the denominator for cost variance and variance at completion calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; PMI Earned Value Management Standard

attributes.name: baseline_completion_date
attributes.description: The approved baseline completion date for the project or WBS element against which the forecast completion date is compared. Captured at forecast time to enable point-in-time variance reporting without requiring a join to the baseline product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; Oracle Primavera P6

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: The current forward-looking forecast date for project or WBS element completion as of the reporting period. Distinct from the baseline completion date. Used for schedule variance calculation, EOT claims, and client reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; Oracle Primavera P6; FIDIC Contract Conditions

attributes.name: contingency_remaining
attributes.description: The remaining contingency budget available for the project or WBS element as of the reporting period, after accounting for approved contingency drawdowns. Tracked separately from the base EAC to support risk-adjusted forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; PMO Governance Framework

attributes.name: cost_trend_indicator
attributes.description: Management assessment of the directional trend in cost performance compared to the prior reporting period. Improving indicates the EAC has decreased; stable indicates no material change; deteriorating indicates the EAC has increased. Used for executive dashboard traffic-light reporting.
attributes.references: PMO Governance Framework; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems

attributes.name: cost_variance
attributes.description: The Cost Variance (CV) representing the difference between the Budget at Completion (BAC) and the Estimate at Completion (EAC), indicating the projected over- or under-run at project completion. Negative values indicate cost overrun. Key P&L and PMO governance metric.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; PMI Earned Value Management Standard

attributes.name: cost_variance_pct
attributes.description: Cost variance expressed as a percentage of the Budget at Completion (BAC), calculated as (BAC - EAC) / BAC × 100. Enables normalized comparison of cost performance across projects of different sizes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; PMI Earned Value Management Standard

attributes.name: cpi
attributes.description: The Cost Performance Index (CPI) as of the reporting period, calculated as Earned Value (EV) divided by Actual Cost (AC). A CPI below 1.0 indicates cost overrun; above 1.0 indicates cost efficiency. Core EVM metric for PMO governance and project health dashboards.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; PMI Earned Value Management Standard; Oracle Primavera P6

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this forecast record was first created in the Databricks Silver Layer, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this forecast record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, AUD). Ensures consistent currency context for multi-currency project portfolios.

attributes.name: eac_cost
attributes.description: The current forward-looking Estimate at Completion (EAC) representing the total forecasted final cost of the project or WBS element as of the reporting period. Core EVM metric used for P&L reporting and PMO governance. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Project Systems.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; PMI Earned Value Management Standard; IFRS 15

attributes.name: eac_movement
attributes.description: The change in Estimate at Completion (EAC) between the current and prior reporting period (current EAC minus prior period EAC). Positive values indicate cost growth; negative values indicate cost reduction. Key metric for P&L bridge and PMO governance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; PMO Governance Framework; IFRS 15

attributes.name: earned_value
attributes.description: The Earned Value (EV), also known as Budgeted Cost of Work Performed (BCWP), representing the budgeted value of work physically completed as of the reporting period. Core EVM input for CPI and SPI calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; PMI Earned Value Management Standard; Oracle Primavera P6

attributes.name: etc_cost
attributes.description: The Estimate to Complete (ETC) representing the forecasted remaining cost required to finish the project or WBS element from the reporting period data date. Calculated as EAC minus actual cost to date. Key input for cash flow forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; PMI Earned Value Management Standard

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert project currency amounts to the reporting/functional currency as of the reporting period date. Required for multi-currency EPC projects and consolidated P&L reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance; IFRS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: final_cost
attributes.description: The management-adjusted forecast of the total final cost at project completion, which may differ from the EAC where management applies judgment overlays, risk provisions, or contingency drawdowns not yet reflected in the bottom-up EAC. Used for P&L reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; IFRS 15; GAAP

attributes.name: forecast_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this forecast record, typically formatted as a project code plus reporting period reference (e.g., PRJ-2024-FCT-007). Used in PMO governance reports and P&L submissions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; PMO Governance Framework

attributes.name: forecast_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the forecast record within the PMO approval workflow. Draft indicates work-in-progress; submitted indicates pending PMO review; approved indicates accepted for P&L reporting; superseded indicates replaced by a newer forecast revision; cancelled indicates withdrawn.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; PMO Governance Framework

attributes.name: forecast_type
attributes.description: Classification of the forecast by its reporting cadence or trigger. Monthly and quarterly forecasts are produced on a rolling basis; annual forecasts align with budget cycles; ad-hoc forecasts are produced for specific management or client events.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; PMO Governance Framework

attributes.name: is_client_reported
attributes.description: Indicates whether this forecast record has been formally reported to the client as part of contractual project reporting obligations. True indicates the forecast has been shared with the client; False indicates it is an internal management forecast only.
attributes.references: FIDIC Contract Conditions; PMO Governance Framework

attributes.name: management_reserve_remaining
attributes.description: The remaining management reserve held at the project level as of the reporting period. Management reserve is distinct from contingency and is controlled by senior management for unknown-unknown risks. Tracked for PMO governance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; PMI PMBOK; PMO Governance Framework

attributes.name: narrative_commentary
attributes.description: Free-text management commentary explaining the key drivers of cost and schedule variances, significant changes from the prior period forecast, risk events, and corrective actions. Required for PMO governance reporting and client-facing project status reports.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; PMO Governance Framework

attributes.name: percent_complete
attributes.description: The overall physical percent complete of the project or WBS element as of the reporting period data date, expressed as a value between 0.00 and 100.00. Used for progress reporting, earned value calculation, and revenue recognition under IFRS 15 percentage-of-completion method.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; Oracle Primavera P6; IFRS 15

attributes.name: planned_value
attributes.description: The Planned Value (PV), also known as Budgeted Cost of Work Scheduled (BCWS), representing the authorized budget allocated to the work scheduled to be completed as of the reporting period data date. Core EVM input for SPI calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; PMI Earned Value Management Standard; Oracle Primavera P6

attributes.name: prior_period_eac
attributes.description: The approved Estimate at Completion (EAC) from the immediately preceding reporting period. Stored on the forecast record to enable period-over-period movement analysis without requiring a self-join, supporting PMO trend reporting and P&L bridge analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; PMO Governance Framework; IFRS 15

attributes.name: reporting_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter code for the functional or reporting currency to which project amounts are converted for consolidated P&L and PMO portfolio reporting. Distinct from the project transaction currency.

attributes.name: reporting_period_date
attributes.description: The principal business event date representing the reporting period cut-off for which this forecast is produced (typically month-end or quarter-end). Aligns with the SAP S/4HANA Project Systems data date and P&L reporting cycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; GAAP

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential revision counter for the forecast within a given reporting period. Increments each time the forecast is revised and resubmitted for the same period, enabling version tracking and audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; PMO Governance Framework

attributes.name: risk_provision_amount
attributes.description: The quantified risk provision included in the forecast final cost to cover identified project risks that have not yet materialized. Distinct from contingency; represents probabilistic risk exposure recognized in the P&L forecast.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; IFRS 37 Provisions; PMO Risk Management Framework

attributes.name: sap_project_version
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA Project Systems project version identifier from which this forecast record was extracted. Enables traceability back to the source system version for audit and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: schedule_trend_indicator
attributes.description: Management assessment of the directional trend in schedule performance compared to the prior reporting period. Improving indicates the forecast completion date has advanced; stable indicates no material change; deteriorating indicates further delay. Used for executive dashboard reporting.
attributes.references: PMO Governance Framework; Oracle Primavera P6

attributes.name: schedule_variance_days
attributes.description: The schedule variance expressed in calendar days, representing the difference between the forecast completion date and the baseline completion date. Negative values indicate schedule delay. Used for Extension of Time (EOT) and Liquidated Damages (LD) exposure assessment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; Oracle Primavera P6; FIDIC Contract Conditions

attributes.name: spi
attributes.description: The Schedule Performance Index (SPI) as of the reporting period, calculated as Earned Value (EV) divided by Planned Value (PV). An SPI below 1.0 indicates schedule delay; above 1.0 indicates schedule efficiency. Core EVM metric for PMO governance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; PMI Earned Value Management Standard; Oracle Primavera P6

attributes.name: tcpi
attributes.description: The To-Complete Performance Index (TCPI) representing the cost efficiency that must be achieved on remaining work to meet the Budget at Completion (BAC) or Estimate at Completion (EAC) target. Calculated as (BAC - EV) / (BAC - AC). Used by PMO to assess forecast achievability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; PMI Earned Value Management Standard

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this forecast record was last modified in the Databricks Silver Layer, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail, change detection, and incremental data pipeline processing.

attributes.name: variance_at_completion
attributes.description: The Variance at Completion (VAC) representing the difference between the Budget at Completion (BAC) and the Estimate at Completion (EAC). Negative values indicate projected cost overrun at project completion. Key metric for P&L exposure reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; PMI Earned Value Management Standard

domains.name: client

Owns client profiles, account hierarchies, JV structures, stakeholder contacts, communication preferences, and relationship history. Captures legal entity name, registration number, tax ID, industry sector, client tier, credit rating, preferred contract type (EPC, GMP, DBB, PPP, BOT), account status, CRM account owner, and segment assignments. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Account object. All other client domain products reference this entity.

attributes.name: parent_account_id

attributes.name: primary_ultimate_parent_account_id

attributes.name: billing_address

attributes.name: bim_requirement_level

attributes.name: client_tier

attributes.name: country_code

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: credit_limit
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding receivable balance approved for this client account. Used by the finance team to manage exposure and payment risk on construction contracts. Expressed in the account's billing currency.

attributes.name: credit_rating
attributes.description: External credit rating assigned to the client organisation by a recognised credit rating agency (e.g., S&P, Moody's, Fitch) or internal credit assessment score. Used for financial risk evaluation, payment terms negotiation, and bonding/surety decisions.

attributes.name: crm_account_code

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: do_not_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether outbound marketing and unsolicited commercial communications to this client account are restricted. Set to True when the client has opted out of communications or is subject to legal/regulatory restrictions. Supports GDPR compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 (Consent); GDPR Article 21 (Right to Object); Privacy Regulations

attributes.name: duns_number

attributes.name: employee_count

attributes.name: eot_policy

attributes.name: hse_compliance_required

attributes.name: is_jv_entity

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; PMO Stakeholder Management Framework

attributes.name: is_decision_maker
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact has final decision-making authority for contract awards, change orders (CO), or project approvals. Critical for bid management and opportunity pipeline qualification in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity Management; FIDIC Contract Administration

attributes.name: is_executive_sponsor
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact holds the role of executive sponsor for the client relationship. Executive sponsors are senior client representatives who champion the construction partnership at the strategic level.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; PMO Stakeholder Engagement Framework

attributes.name: is_primary_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is the designated primary point of contact for the client account. Only one contact per account should be flagged as primary. Used to route official correspondence and contract notifications.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official job title or position of the contact within their organisation (e.g., Project Director, Procurement Manager, Chief Engineer). Used to identify the contact's functional role in client engagement and bid management.

attributes.name: last_activity_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent logged activity (call, email, meeting, site visit) with this contact in Salesforce CRM. Used to measure engagement recency and identify at-risk relationships in client retention analytics.

attributes.name: last_meeting_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent in-person or virtual meeting held with this contact. Used by account managers to track face-to-face engagement frequency and support relationship health assessments.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; PMO Stakeholder Engagement Framework

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the contact record in the source Salesforce CRM system. Used for incremental data loading, change data capture (CDC), and audit trail maintenance in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 Audit Logging; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Family name or surname of the individual stakeholder contact. Combined with first_name to form the full display name used in client-facing communications and CRM reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: linkedin_url
attributes.description: LinkedIn professional profile URL for the contact. Used by business development and account management teams for relationship intelligence, stakeholder research, and pre-bid engagement in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 (Lawful Basis for Processing); Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: mailing_city
attributes.description: City component of the contact's mailing address. Used in conjunction with mailing_street, mailing_state, and mailing_country for complete address resolution in client correspondence.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: mailing_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the contact's mailing address (e.g., USA, GBR, ARE). Used for international project correspondence and GDPR/privacy jurisdiction determination.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR Article 44 (International Transfers); Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: mailing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code component of the contact's mailing address. Used for geographic segmentation, regional reporting, and formal document delivery in construction project administration.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: mailing_state
attributes.description: State or province component of the contact's mailing address. Supports regional segmentation and compliance with jurisdiction-specific regulatory reporting requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: mailing_street
attributes.description: Street address component of the contact's mailing address. Used for formal correspondence, contract document delivery, and regulatory notifications in construction project administration.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: mobile_phone
attributes.description: Mobile or cell phone number for the contact. Used for urgent site communications, HSE notifications, and out-of-hours contact during critical project milestones.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for account managers to record qualitative observations, relationship context, stakeholder preferences, and strategic notes about the contact. Supports informed client engagement and bid strategy preparation.

attributes.name: phone
attributes.description: Primary business phone number for the contact, including country and area code. Used for direct communication during project execution, bid clarifications, and contract administration.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: preferred_communication_channel
attributes.description: The contact's preferred method of communication for project correspondence, meeting invitations, and bid-related notifications. Sourced from Salesforce CRM and used to personalise outreach in opportunity pipeline management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; GDPR Article 7 (Consent)

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code representing the contact's preferred language for written and verbal communication (e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'ar', 'zh'). Supports multilingual project environments common in global EPC and infrastructure projects.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1 Language Codes; GDPR Article 12 (Transparent Communication)

attributes.name: relationship_health
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the current health of the business relationship with this contact, as evaluated by the account manager or business development team. Used in CRM pipeline forecasting and client retention strategies.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; PMO Stakeholder Engagement Framework

attributes.name: salutation
attributes.description: Formal honorific or title prefix for the contact (e.g., Mr., Ms., Dr.) used in official correspondence, contract documents, and client communications.

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: Origin channel through which this contact was acquired or first identified (e.g., CRM import, referral, industry conference, Request for Proposal (RFP) response, website enquiry, partner introduction). Supports lead source analytics in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Source; PMO Business Development Framework

products.name: account_hierarchy
products.description: Defines parent-child organizational relationships between client accounts, supporting multi-tier corporate structures such as holding companies, subsidiaries, regional offices, and JV (Joint Venture) entities. Captures parent account, child account, hierarchy level, relationship type (subsidiary, JV partner, branch), effective dates, and ownership percentage. Enables consolidated reporting across enterprise client groups.

attributes.name: account_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each parent-child account hierarchy relationship record in the construction client domain.

attributes.name: child_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the child account in the hierarchy (e.g., subsidiary, regional office, JV entity, or branch). References the client account that sits one level below the parent in the corporate structure.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Hierarchy; IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements

attributes.name: parent_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent account in the hierarchy (e.g., holding company, group entity, or prime contractor). References the client account that sits one level above the child in the corporate structure.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Hierarchy; IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval status of this hierarchy relationship record. Tracks the governance lifecycle from initial draft through legal/compliance review to final approval, particularly important for JV and PPP structures requiring board or regulatory sign-off.
attributes.references: Aconex Workflow Approvals; Salesforce CRM Approval Process; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual or authority who formally approved this hierarchy relationship (e.g., Chief Financial Officer, Legal Counsel, Board Resolution reference). Supports audit trail and governance compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; Corporate Governance Standards; Aconex Workflow

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which this hierarchy relationship was formally approved by the designated authority (e.g., board resolution date, legal sign-off date). Null if not yet approved.
attributes.references: Aconex Workflow Approvals; IFRS 10; Corporate Governance Standards

attributes.name: arrangement_type
attributes.description: Classifies the overarching commercial or legal arrangement governing this hierarchy relationship. 'corporate' = standard corporate ownership; 'jv' = Joint Venture (JV); 'ppp' = Public-Private Partnership (PPP); 'bot' = Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT); 'consortium' = project-specific consortium; 'spe' = Special Purpose Entity.
attributes.references: IFRS 11 Joint Arrangements; FIDIC; PPP/BOT Regulatory Frameworks

attributes.name: consolidation_method
attributes.description: Accounting consolidation method applied to this hierarchy relationship for financial reporting. 'full' = full consolidation (>50% control); 'proportionate' = proportionate consolidation for JV; 'equity' = equity method for associates; 'none' = no consolidation (e.g., branch or division).
attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; IFRS 11 Joint Arrangements; GAAP ASC 810

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the jurisdiction in which this hierarchy relationship is legally registered or primarily operative (e.g., USA, GBR, ARE, AUS).
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 Country Codes; GDPR Article 44 (Cross-border data transfers)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this account hierarchy relationship record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance with data governance standards.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); Databricks Lakehouse Audit

attributes.name: crm_hierarchy_code
attributes.description: External identifier for this hierarchy relationship as recorded in Salesforce CRM. Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the CRM system of record.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Hierarchy; SAP S/4HANA Business Partner

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to financial transactions and reporting within this hierarchy relationship (e.g., USD, GBP, AED). Used for multi-currency consolidation in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this hierarchy relationship record was sourced (e.g., Salesforce CRM, SAP S/4HANA). Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation in the Databricks Lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage; SAP S/4HANA; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: dissolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the JV, consortium, or subsidiary relationship was formally dissolved or wound up. Applicable primarily to JV (Joint Venture) and SPE (Special Purpose Entity) arrangements. Null if not dissolved.
attributes.references: IFRS 11 Joint Arrangements; FIDIC Joint Venture Guidelines; Companies Act

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this parent-child hierarchy relationship becomes active and binding. Used for temporal validity tracking and historical hierarchy reconstruction.
attributes.references: IFRS 10; Salesforce CRM Account Hierarchy; ISO 8601 Date Standard

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date on which this parent-child hierarchy relationship ceases to be active. Null indicates the relationship is currently open-ended and active. Supports historical hierarchy versioning and corporate restructuring tracking.
attributes.references: IFRS 10; Salesforce CRM Account Hierarchy; ISO 8601 Date Standard

attributes.name: erp_hierarchy_code
attributes.description: External identifier for this hierarchy relationship as recorded in SAP S/4HANA Business Partner Hierarchy. Supports financial consolidation and intercompany transaction management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Business Partner Hierarchy; IFRS 10

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or territory associated with this hierarchy relationship (e.g., North America, Middle East, Asia Pacific). Used for regional consolidated reporting and client portfolio analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Territory Management; Construction Industry Regional Reporting

attributes.name: governing_law_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction whose laws govern this hierarchy relationship agreement (e.g., USA, GBR, SGP). Relevant for cross-border JV and PPP structures.
attributes.references: FIDIC Contract Principles; ISO 3166-1; GDPR Article 44; IFRS

attributes.name: hierarchy_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this hierarchy relationship, used for cross-system referencing in SAP S/4HANA and Salesforce CRM integrations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Business Partner Hierarchy; Salesforce CRM Account Hierarchy

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric depth of the child account within the corporate hierarchy tree. Level 1 represents the ultimate parent (root), with each subsequent level incrementing by 1. Enables consolidated reporting across multi-tier enterprise client groups.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Hierarchy; SAP S/4HANA Business Partner Hierarchy

attributes.name: hierarchy_path
attributes.description: Full materialized path string representing the ancestry chain from root to child account (e.g., '/1001/1045/1078'). Supports efficient tree traversal queries and consolidated reporting without recursive joins.

attributes.name: hierarchy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the hierarchy relationship. 'active' = currently in force; 'inactive' = no longer operative; 'pending' = awaiting approval or legal completion; 'dissolved' = JV or entity formally wound up; 'suspended' = temporarily on hold pending review.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Hierarchy; IFRS 10; FIDIC Contract Principles

attributes.name: hierarchy_version
attributes.description: Version number of this hierarchy relationship record, incremented each time the relationship is modified (e.g., ownership percentage change, restructuring). Supports temporal versioning and audit history.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 11179; SAP S/4HANA Change Management; IFRS 10

attributes.name: is_primary_hierarchy
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the primary or default hierarchy relationship for the child account when multiple hierarchy paths exist (e.g., a subsidiary may belong to both a geographic and a functional hierarchy). True = primary hierarchy; False = secondary or alternate hierarchy.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Hierarchy; SAP S/4HANA Business Partner Hierarchy

attributes.name: jv_agreement_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Joint Venture (JV) agreement document governing this hierarchy relationship, where applicable. Links to the formal JV deed or partnership agreement registered in Aconex or the document management system.
attributes.references: IFRS 11 Joint Arrangements; FIDIC Joint Venture Guidelines; Aconex Document Management

attributes.name: lead_partner_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the parent account is the designated lead partner or managing entity in a JV (Joint Venture) or consortium arrangement. True = lead/managing partner; False = non-lead participant.
attributes.references: FIDIC Joint Venture Guidelines; IFRS 11 Joint Arrangements

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional business context, legal annotations, or operational notes related to this hierarchy relationship (e.g., special governance arrangements, board resolution references, regulatory conditions).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account; Aconex Document Management

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of ownership or equity stake held by the parent account in the child account. Critical for JV (Joint Venture) and subsidiary consolidation under IFRS 10/11. Ranges from 0.00 to 100.00.
attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; IFRS 11 Joint Arrangements; GAAP ASC 810

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the parent-child relationship. 'subsidiary' indicates full or majority ownership; 'jv_partner' denotes a Joint Venture (JV) arrangement; 'branch' indicates a regional or operational office; 'division' indicates an internal business unit; 'holding' indicates a holding company structure; 'associate' indicates a minority-stake or affiliated entity. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: subsidiary|jv_partner|branch|division|holding|associate|consortium_member|spe — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; IFRS 11 Joint Arrangements; Salesforce CRM Account Hierarchy

attributes.name: restructuring_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the business reason for creating or modifying this hierarchy relationship (e.g., corporate merger, JV formation, divestiture, regional reorganization). Provides audit context for hierarchy changes.
attributes.references: IFRS 10; Corporate Governance Standards; SAP S/4HANA Business Partner

attributes.name: sector_classification
attributes.description: Classifies the client sector for the hierarchy relationship, enabling segmentation of consolidated reporting across public-sector, private-sector, PPP (Public-Private Partnership), government, and NGO client groups.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Segmentation; Construction Industry Sector Standards

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this hierarchy record in the originating source system (e.g., Salesforce Account Hierarchy ID or SAP Business Partner Hierarchy node ID). Enables end-to-end data lineage from source to silver layer.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage; Salesforce CRM; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this account hierarchy relationship record was last modified. Used for change detection, incremental data loading, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); Databricks Lakehouse Audit

attributes.name: voting_rights_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of voting rights held by the parent account in the child entity. May differ from ownership percentage in JV (Joint Venture) or PPP (Public-Private Partnership) structures where governance rights are separately negotiated.
attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; IFRS 11 Joint Arrangements

products.name: address
products.description: Physical and mailing addresses associated with client accounts, including registered office, billing address, project site liaison office, and correspondence address. Captures address type, street, city, state/province, postal code, country, GIS coordinates, and address validation status. Supports multi-jurisdiction clients operating across regions.

attributes.name: address_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each client address record in the Construction data platform. Serves as the primary key for the client_address entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent client account to which this address belongs. Links the address record to the client master in the CRM (Customer Relationship Management) system (Salesforce CRM).

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: add column contact_id (BIGINT) with FK to client.contact.contact_id - addresses should be linkable to individual contacts, not just accounts

attributes.name: address_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the address record. Active indicates the address is in current use; inactive means it is no longer used; pending_validation awaits address verification; superseded means it has been replaced by a newer address; undeliverable indicates mail or correspondence has been returned.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Address Management; USPS Address Quality Standards

attributes.name: address_type
attributes.description: Classifies the functional purpose of the address. Registered office is the legal domicile; billing is used for invoice delivery; correspondence is the preferred mailing address; project_site_liaison is the on-site contact office for a specific project; head_office and branch_office denote organisational hierarchy locations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: registered_office|billing|correspondence|project_site_liaison|head_office|branch_office — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Address Type; FIDIC Contract Administration

attributes.name: attention_to
attributes.description: Name of the specific individual or department to whom correspondence should be directed at this address (e.g., 'Attn: Contracts Manager' or 'Attn: Finance Department'). Used in formal contract correspondence and RFI (Request for Information) transmittals.
attributes.references: FIDIC Contract Administration; Aconex Correspondence Management

attributes.name: building_name
attributes.description: Name of the building or complex at this address (e.g., 'Empire State Building', 'One Canada Square', 'Dubai World Trade Centre'). Used for precise address identification in dense urban environments and for formal correspondence headers.
attributes.references: ISO 19160-1 Addressing; Universal Postal Union (UPU) Standards

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: Name of the city, town, or municipality in which the address is located. Used for regional client segmentation, jurisdiction determination, and multi-city project coordination.
attributes.references: ISO 19160-1 Addressing; Universal Postal Union (UPU) Standards

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the address (e.g., USA, GBR, AUS, ARE). Supports multi-jurisdiction client management across global construction operations including EPC (Engineering, Procurement and Construction) and PPP (Public-Private Partnership) projects.

attributes.name: country_name
attributes.description: Full English name of the country corresponding to the country_code. Stored for display and reporting purposes to avoid repeated lookups against the ISO country reference table.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this address record was first created in the data platform. Provides the audit trail creation marker for data governance and GDPR compliance tracking.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); ISO/IEC 27001 Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this address became or becomes effective for the client. Supports temporal address management, enabling historical address tracking for contract administration and legal notice purposes.
attributes.references: FIDIC Contract Administration; ISO 8601 Date Format; GDPR Data Accuracy Principle

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date on which this address ceases to be effective for the client. Null indicates the address is currently active with no planned end date. Used for temporal address history management and superseded address tracking.
attributes.references: FIDIC Contract Administration; ISO 8601 Date Format

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: General email address associated with this address location (e.g., a departmental or office inbox). Used for electronic correspondence, transmittal delivery via Aconex, and formal notice under contract. Distinct from individual contact email addresses.
attributes.references: FIDIC General Conditions of Contract Clause 1.3; GDPR Article 4; RFC 5321 SMTP

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: Fax number associated with this address location. Retained for clients and jurisdictions where fax remains a legally recognised method of formal notice delivery under FIDIC contract conditions.
attributes.references: FIDIC General Conditions of Contract Clause 1.3 (Communications); ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: floor_level
attributes.description: Floor or level number within a building at this address (e.g., 'Level 12', 'Ground Floor', 'Basement 2'). Used for precise delivery instructions and visitor access coordination for client site visits.

attributes.name: format_type
attributes.description: Indicates the structural format of the address to support correct rendering and printing. Western follows street-city-state-postal conventions; eastern follows country-specific formats (e.g., Japan, China); po_box is a post office box address; free_form is an unstructured address entry.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union (UPU) S42 Addressing Standard; ISO 19160-1

attributes.name: is_billing_address
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address is designated as the billing address for invoice delivery and accounts receivable correspondence. Used by SAP S/4HANA AR (Accounts Receivable) module for invoice routing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Accounts Receivable (AR); IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address is the primary address for the client account. Only one address per client should be flagged as primary at any given time. Used to determine the default address for correspondence and contract documentation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Primary Address Flag; FIDIC Contract Administration

attributes.name: is_registered_office
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address is the legally registered office address of the client entity. Required for contract execution, legal notices under FIDIC conditions, and regulatory compliance filings.
attributes.references: FIDIC General Conditions of Contract; Companies Act (Jurisdiction-Specific); GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Legal and regulatory jurisdiction code applicable to this address, combining ISO 3166-1 country code and subdivision code (e.g., US-CA for California, AU-NSW for New South Wales). Used for tax jurisdiction mapping, OSHA/EPA regulatory compliance, and contract law determination.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2 Country Subdivision Codes; OSHA Jurisdiction Standards; EPA Regulatory Jurisdiction

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the address in decimal degrees (WGS 84 datum). Supports GIS (Geographic Information System) mapping, proximity analysis to active construction sites, and spatial analytics for project planning.
attributes.references: ISO 6709 Geographic Point Location; WGS 84 Geodetic Datum

attributes.name: line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line including building number, street name, and suite or unit number. Represents the first line of the postal address as used in official correspondence and contract documentation.
attributes.references: USPS Postal Addressing Standards; GDPR Article 4; ISO 19160-1 Addressing

attributes.name: line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for additional location details such as floor number, building name, industrial estate, or campus identifier. Optional field used when the primary line is insufficient.
attributes.references: USPS Postal Addressing Standards; ISO 19160-1 Addressing

attributes.name: line_3
attributes.description: Tertiary address line used for additional locality or district information, particularly relevant for international clients in regions where addresses require more than two street lines.
attributes.references: ISO 19160-1 Addressing; Universal Postal Union (UPU) Standards

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the address in decimal degrees (WGS 84 datum). Used in conjunction with latitude for GIS (Geographic Information System) spatial analysis, site proximity calculations, and mapping of client office locations.
attributes.references: ISO 6709 Geographic Point Location; WGS 84 Geodetic Datum

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional address-related notes or delivery instructions (e.g., 'Security clearance required for entry', 'Use rear entrance', 'Deliveries accepted Monday-Friday only'). Supports operational coordination for site visits and document deliveries.
attributes.references: Procore Construction Management; Aconex Document Management

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary telephone number associated with this address location. Used for direct contact with the client office at this address for project coordination, site liaison, and contract administration purposes.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164 International Telephone Numbering; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: po_box_number
attributes.description: Post Office (PO) Box number for clients who receive correspondence via a PO Box rather than a street address. Common for government agencies, public-sector clients, and clients in regions where PO Box delivery is standard.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union (UPU) Standards; USPS Publication 28

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the address. Used for mail routing, geographic clustering of clients, and regional analytics. Format varies by country (e.g., 5-digit US ZIP, alphanumeric UK postcode).
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union (UPU) S42 Standard; USPS Publication 28

attributes.name: preferred_correspondence_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 or ISO 639-2 language code indicating the preferred language for correspondence sent to this address (e.g., 'en' for English, 'fr' for French, 'ar' for Arabic). Supports multilingual client communication in international construction markets.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1/639-2 Language Codes; FIDIC Contract Administration; GDPR Article 12 (Transparent Communication)

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: Broad geographic region grouping for the address (e.g., North America, Middle East, Asia Pacific, Europe). Used for regional portfolio reporting, business development segmentation, and PMO (Project Management Office) territory alignment.
attributes.references: UN M.49 Standard for Geographic Regions; Salesforce CRM Territory Management

attributes.name: source_system_address_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this address record in the originating operational system (e.g., Salesforce CRM Address ID, SAP S/4HANA partner address number). Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and cross-system deduplication.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; SAP S/4HANA Business Partner Address; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, territory, or region within the country. Used for regulatory jurisdiction mapping, tax compliance, and regional reporting across multi-jurisdiction construction clients.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2 Country Subdivision Codes; IFRS/GAAP Jurisdictional Reporting

attributes.name: suite_unit_number
attributes.description: Suite, unit, or office number within a building at this address. Provides the final level of address precision for multi-tenant buildings where multiple client offices may occupy the same floor.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Specific tax jurisdiction code for the address as used in SAP S/4HANA tax determination. May differ from the general jurisdiction code in federal/state/local tax overlay scenarios. Used for sales tax, VAT, and withholding tax calculations on client invoices.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Tax Determination; IFRS/GAAP Tax Reporting; IBC Tax Jurisdiction

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the address location (e.g., America/New_York, Asia/Dubai, Australia/Sydney). Used for scheduling client communications, meeting coordination, and project milestone notifications across global construction operations.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this address record was last modified in the data platform. Used for change detection, incremental data loading in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); ISO/IEC 27001 Audit Trail Requirements; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Capture

attributes.name: validation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the address was last validated against a postal authority or address verification service. Used to schedule re-validation cycles and assess data quality freshness.
attributes.references: USPS Address Validation Standards; ISO 8601 Date Format

attributes.name: validation_source
attributes.description: Name of the service or system used to validate the address (e.g., USPS, Google Maps API, Loqate, SmartyStreets). Provides traceability for data quality audits and vendor management.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28; Universal Postal Union (UPU) Standards

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Result of the address validation process against a postal authority or third-party address verification service. Validated means the address has been confirmed as deliverable; not_validated means validation has not been attempted; failed means the address could not be verified; partial means only some components were verified.
attributes.references: USPS Address Validation Standards; Universal Postal Union (UPU) S42

products.name: client_opportunity
products.description: Pre-award commercial opportunity record tracking potential construction projects in the BD pipeline. Captures opportunity name, client account, project type, estimated contract value, delivery model (EPC, GMP, DBB, PPP), bid/no-bid decision, probability of win, expected NTP date, pipeline stage, BD owner, and win/loss outcome. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Opportunity object. SSOT for pipeline forecasting.

attributes.name: client_opportunity_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the client opportunity record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for the client_opportunity data product.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account (project owner, developer, or sponsor) associated with this opportunity. Maps to the Salesforce CRM Account object.

attributes.name: prequalification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.client_prequalification. Business justification: client_opportunity carries a prequalification_status (STRING) field that is a denormalized copy of the authoritative prequalification status held in client_prequalification. Adding client_prequalifica

attributes.name: actual_award_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contract was formally awarded. Populated upon win outcome. Used for win/loss analysis and BD cycle time measurement.

attributes.name: bid_cost_estimate

attributes.name: bid_no_bid_decision
attributes.description: Formal decision outcome from the bid/no-bid review process indicating whether the company will pursue this opportunity. Pending_review indicates the decision gate has not yet been completed.

attributes.name: bid_no_bid_decision_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal bid/no-bid decision was made and recorded. Used for governance audit trails and BD cycle time analysis.

attributes.name: bid_submission_date

attributes.name: bim_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client mandates Building Information Modeling (BIM) as a project delivery requirement. True = BIM is contractually required. Drives technology and resource planning for the bid.

attributes.name: boq_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Bill of Quantities (BOQ) has been issued by the client as part of the tender package. True = BOQ provided; False = lump-sum or design-build without BOQ. Affects estimating approach and bid strategy.

attributes.name: competitor_names
