attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the opportunity record was first created in the source CRM system. Represents the business event of opportunity identification and entry into the BD pipeline. Used for pipeline age and BD cycle time analytics.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the estimated contract value and weighted pipeline value (e.g., USD, EUR, AED, GBP). Required for multi-currency pipeline consolidation.

attributes.name: delivery_model
attributes.description: Contract delivery model under which the construction project will be executed. Drives risk allocation and commercial strategy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EPC|GMP|DBB|DB|PPP|BOT|FIDIC — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the scope, nature, and key characteristics of the construction opportunity. Provides context for BD team members reviewing the pipeline and supports AI/ML-based opportunity classification.

attributes.name: esg_requirements
attributes.description: Description of any Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) requirements specified by the client for this opportunity (e.g., carbon targets, local content requirements, diversity commitments). Free-text field for BD qualification notes.

attributes.name: estimated_contract_value
attributes.description: Estimated total contract value of the opportunity in the reporting currency. Used for pipeline forecasting, revenue planning, and bid/no-bid decision thresholds. Raw commercial estimate; not a committed figure.

attributes.name: expected_award_date

attributes.name: expected_ntp_date

attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity; FIDIC Contract Conditions; IFRS 15

attributes.name: is_jv_bid
attributes.description: Indicates whether this opportunity is being pursued as a Joint Venture (JV) arrangement. True = JV bid; False = sole-entity bid. Drives JV governance and risk review processes.

attributes.name: jv_partner_names
attributes.description: Names of Joint Venture (JV) partners with whom the company intends to bid on this opportunity. Relevant for JV-structured bids common in large infrastructure and EPC projects. Confidential commercial information.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: leed_certification_required

attributes.name: loss_reason

attributes.name: next_action
attributes.description: Description of the next planned business development action required to advance this opportunity (e.g., 'Submit EOI by 15-Mar', 'Attend client briefing', 'Complete bid/no-bid review'). Operational field used by BD team for pipeline management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity Next Step; PMO BD Pipeline Governance

attributes.name: next_action_due_date

attributes.name: opportunity_name

attributes.name: opportunity_number

attributes.name: opportunity_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of the opportunity record indicating whether it is actively pursued, won, lost, on hold, or cancelled. Distinct from pipeline_stage which tracks the BD workflow step.

attributes.name: pipeline_stage

attributes.name: project_duration_months

attributes.name: project_location_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country where the construction project will be executed (e.g., USA, ARE, GBR). Used for geographic pipeline analysis and regulatory compliance scoping.

attributes.name: project_location_region
attributes.description: State, province, or region where the construction project will be executed. Used for regional pipeline reporting, resource planning, and jurisdictional compliance (e.g., OSHA state plans, local building codes).
attributes.references: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration); IBC (International Building Code)

attributes.name: project_type
attributes.description: Classification of the construction project type (e.g., highway, airport, bridge, power plant, residential, commercial, industrial). Used for market segmentation and capability matching. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: highway|airport|bridge|power_plant|residential|commercial|industrial|water_treatment|rail|data_center — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IBC (International Building Code); ASCE (American Society of Civil Engineers)

attributes.name: rfp_issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the client issued the Request for Proposal (RFP) or Invitation to Tender (ITT). Marks the formal start of the bid preparation phase.

attributes.name: rfq_number

attributes.name: sector
attributes.description: Sector classification of the client commissioning the work: public-sector (government/municipal), private-sector (developer/corporate), or PPP/BOT (public-private partnership or build-operate-transfer arrangement). Used for client segmentation and reporting.

attributes.name: source_crm_opportunity_code
attributes.description: Original opportunity identifier from the Salesforce CRM system of record. Used for data lineage, cross-system reconciliation, and traceability back to the operational source.

attributes.name: strategic_priority

attributes.name: weighted_pipeline_value

attributes.name: channel

attributes.name: client_seniority_level
attributes.description: Highest seniority level of client-side attendees present at the interaction (e.g., C-Suite, VP/Director, Manager). Supports executive engagement tracking and account strategy analytics.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this interaction record was first created in the source CRM system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: crm_activity_code

attributes.name: crm_record_type
attributes.description: Salesforce CRM object type from which this interaction record was sourced (Task, Event, Call Log, or Email Log). Supports data lineage and source system traceability.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the entertainment cost amount (e.g., USD, AUD, GBP). Supports multi-currency expense reporting.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of the interaction including agenda, topics discussed, key decisions made, and context. Supports account review preparation and relationship history tracking.

attributes.name: duration_minutes

attributes.name: end_timestamp

attributes.name: entertainment_cost

attributes.name: external_attendee_count

attributes.name: followup_completed

attributes.name: gifts_hospitality_declared

attributes.name: interaction_date

attributes.name: interaction_status

attributes.name: interaction_type

attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Activity Type; Internal BD Process Standard

attributes.name: internal_attendee_count
attributes.description: Total number of internal employees who participated in the interaction. Supports BD resource allocation analysis and engagement intensity KPIs.

attributes.name: internal_attendees
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of internal employees (names or employee IDs) who participated in the interaction. Supports account review preparation and engagement coverage analysis.

attributes.name: is_billable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the time or cost associated with this interaction is billable to the client or project. Relevant for reimbursable contract types (e.g., cost-plus, EPC reimbursable).

attributes.name: is_executive_engagement
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interaction involved C-suite or executive-level participants from either the internal organisation or the client side. Supports executive engagement KPI reporting and account strategy reviews.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: contact_id

attributes.name: credit_insurance_limit_amount

attributes.name: credit_limit_change_reason

attributes.name: credit_review_frequency

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: effective_until_date

attributes.name: external_credit_rating

attributes.name: last_credit_review_date

attributes.name: liquidated_damages_exposure_amount

domains.name: contract
domains.description: Authoritative contract repository governing all contractual agreements including FIDIC-based EPC, GMP (Guaranteed Maximum Price), lump-sum, and unit-rate contracts. Owns CO (Change Order) logs, LD (Liquidated Damages) provisions, DLP (Defects Liability Period) terms, EOT (Extension of Time) entitlements, payment schedules, and contract milestone administration.

products.name: agreement
products.description: Master contract record representing the authoritative SSOT for all contractual agreements in the construction domain. Captures FIDIC-based EPC, GMP (Guaranteed Maximum Price), lump-sum, unit-rate, DB (Design-Build), DBB (Design-Bid-Build), PPP (Public-Private Partnership), and BOT (Build-Operate-Transfer) contract types via a type classification attribute. Stores contract identity, scope narrative, detailed scope of works including WBS (Work Breakdown Structure) reference, deliverable descriptions, technical specifications reference, BOQ (Bill of Quantities) linkage, geographic boundaries, and exclusions. Records execution dates, NTP (Notice to Proceed) date, contract value, currency, governing law, dispute resolution mechanism, contract status lifecycle from award through close-out, and particular/special conditions that modify standard form terms. Maintains status transition history for audit and lifecycle analytics. Records all formal amendments including supplemental agreements, deed of variations, and novation agreements with amendment number, type, effective date, revised contract value, revised completion date, and execution status. Serves as the authoritative scope baseline against which change orders and EOT claims are evaluated.

products.name: contract_milestone
products.description: Tracks contractually obligated milestones, key dates, and DLP (Defects Liability Period) obligations within a contract. Covers NTP (Notice to Proceed), sectional completion dates, practical completion, DLP start/end dates, performance certificate issuance, and final certificate dates. Records planned date, forecast date, actual achieved date, milestone value (if linked to payment), milestone type, and milestone status. Manages the complete DLP register including defects notified by the employer, contractor rectification commitments, rectification deadlines, outstanding defects at DLP expiry, and the transition from practical completion through to final certificate issuance and retention release. Used for LD (Liquidated Damages) trigger assessment, payment certification, DLP management, and retention release scheduling.

products.name: payment_schedule
products.description: Defines the contractual payment schedule governing when and how much the employer is obligated to pay the contractor, including full advance payment (mobilization payment) lifecycle management. Captures payment terms, payment intervals, payment due dates, payment method, currency, and supports both milestone-based and time-based payment structures as defined under FIDIC and GMP contract forms. Manages the complete advance payment lifecycle: advance payment amount, percentage of contract value, disbursement date, repayment/recovery schedule, cumulative amount recovered through payment certificate deductions, outstanding advance balance, advance payment guarantee reference, and advance payment status from initial disbursement through full recovery. Serves as the authoritative SSOT for all payment scheduling and advance payment tracking, alongside progress payment and retention release scheduling.

products.name: payment_certificate
products.description: Transactional record of each interim payment certificate (IPC) and final payment certificate (FPC) issued under a main contract or subcontract. Captures certified amount, retention deducted, advance payment recovery, LD deductions, net amount due, certification date, certifier identity, payment due date, and actual payment date. Supports both main contract certification (FIDIC Clause 14) and subcontract payment certification via a contract-level discriminator distinguishing main contract from subcontract certificates. Records subcontract payment applications, certified amounts, and enables back-to-back payment flow management between main contract receipts and subcontractor disbursements. Supports cash flow forecasting, pay-when-paid clause administration, and unified payment reconciliation across the full contract hierarchy.

Captures subcontract type (domestic, nominated, specialist), subcontract value, scope summary, back-to-back terms with main contract, NTP date, completion date, and subcontract status. Distinct from the subcontractor domain master — this entity owns the contractual instrument, not the subcontractor party profile.

Enables back-to-back payment flow management between main contract receipts and subcontractor disbursements, supporting cash flow forecasting and pay-when-paid clause administration.

domains.name: site
domains.description: Owns daily site execution data including daily logs, production tracking, work fronts, crew assignments, site logistics, mobilization/demobilization, concrete pours, earthworks volumes, and field progress measurements. Integrates with HCSS HeavyJob for cost coding and production tracking and Procore for daily logs and field management. Supports earned value computation feeding the project domain.

products.name: work_front
products.description: Master record for each active work front (zone, area, or face) on a construction site where concurrent work activities are executed. Tracks work front identity, location coordinates (GPS/grid reference), zone classification, active/inactive status, assigned foreman, mobilization date, demobilization date, current phase, associated WBS element, and parent site reference. Serves as the primary spatial and organizational anchor for all site-level transactional records — every operational product in this domain holds a mandatory or optional FK to work_front. The work_front-centric topology enables spatial aggregation of production, cost, progress, and resource data by zone.

attributes.name: work_front_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the work front record. Primary key for the work_front master entity in the site domain.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Each work front operates under a defined design scope package; linking supports scope‑freeze and change‑control processes.

attributes.name: bim_model_id

attributes.name: cost_account_id

attributes.name: drawing_id

attributes.name: finance_cost_code_id

attributes.name: party_id

attributes.name: permit_to_work_id

attributes.name: risk_assessment_id

attributes.name: scope_id

attributes.name: subcontract_id

attributes.name: supervisor_craft_worker_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.craft_worker. Business justification: Each work front requires an identified responsible supervisor (craft_worker) for HSE accountability, daily sign-off authority, and regulatory compliance reporting. Construction domain experts expect a

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.swms. Business justification: Every work front requires an approved SWMS before work commences — a mandatory HSE pre-work requirement in construction. 'swms_reference' is a denormalized text reference to the swms entity; replacing

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Subcontractor vendor coordination: work_front.is_subcontracted flag requires knowing which procurement vendor is executing the front for HSE compliance, daily coordination, and progress payment certif

attributes.name: access_restriction
attributes.description: The access control classification for this work front. 'permit_required' indicates a Permit to Work (PTW) is mandatory before entry; 'restricted_zone' limits access to authorised personnel; 'exclusion_zone' prohibits all non-essential access. Supports HSE compliance.

attributes.name: actual_crew_size
attributes.description: The actual number of direct labour workers present at this work front on the most recent reporting day. Compared against planned_crew_size to identify under-manning and productivity risks.

attributes.name: actual_production_qty
attributes.description: Cumulative actual production quantity achieved at this work front to date, expressed in the production_unit. Sourced from HCSS HeavyJob production tracking and field measurements. Used to compute earned value.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob – Production Tracking; EVM Standards (ANSI/EIA-748)

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which work commenced at this work front. Compared against planned_start_date to compute schedule variance. Sourced from Procore daily logs or HCSS HeavyJob time tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Progress Tracking; Procore – Daily Logs

attributes.name: area_sqm
attributes.description: Total plan area of the work front in square metres. Used as the principal quantitative measure of the resource for production rate calculations, crew density planning, and progress measurement.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob – Production Tracking; BOQ Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this work front record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation marker for data lineage and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 – Record Control; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: demobilization_date
attributes.description: The date on which all resources were demobilized from this work front and active work ceased. Null if the work front is still active. Used to calculate work front duration and close out cost codes.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Baseline Management; HCSS HeavyJob – Equipment Hours

attributes.name: elevation_m
attributes.description: Reference elevation of the work front above mean sea level in metres. Critical for earthworks volume calculations, drainage design, and structural level control.
attributes.references: ASCE 7 – Structural Engineering Standards; Autodesk BIM 360 – 3D Modeling

attributes.name: environmental_sensitivity
attributes.description: Classification of the environmental sensitivity of the work front location. 'sensitive' and 'protected' areas require additional environmental controls and monitoring per ISO 14001 and EPA requirements. 'remediation_required' indicates contaminated ground conditions.
attributes.references: EPA Environmental Regulations; ISO 14001; LEED Construction Activity Pollution Prevention

attributes.name: forecast_finish_date
attributes.description: Current forecast date for completion of all work at this work front, updated based on actual progress and remaining work. Supports look-ahead scheduling and early warning of delays.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Progress Tracking; CPM Scheduling Standards

attributes.name: front_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies the work front within the project or site. Used in daily logs, production reports, and cost coding in HCSS HeavyJob and Procore.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob – Cost Coding; Procore – Daily Logs

attributes.name: front_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the work front (e.g., 'Zone A – Pile Cap Excavation', 'North Abutment Face'). Used in daily logs, progress reports, and field management interfaces.
attributes.references: Procore – Field Management; HCSS HeavyJob – Production Tracking

attributes.name: front_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the work front. 'mobilizing' indicates resources are being deployed; 'active' indicates concurrent work is in progress; 'suspended' indicates a temporary hold; 'demobilized' indicates resources have been withdrawn; 'completed' indicates all planned work is finished.
attributes.references: Procore – Field Management; HCSS HeavyJob – Production Tracking

attributes.name: front_type
attributes.description: Classification of the spatial unit represented by this work front. Distinguishes between zone (broad area), area (defined boundary), face (excavation or structural face), sector, corridor, level (floor/elevation), or bay. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: zone|area|face|sector|corridor|level|bay — promote to reference product if additional types are required]
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob – Production Tracking; Procore – Field Management

attributes.name: grid_reference
attributes.description: Site-specific grid reference or chainage notation (e.g., 'Grid E5-F6', 'CH 1+200 to CH 1+450') used in engineering drawings and BIM models to locate the work front. Complements GPS coordinates for internal site navigation.
attributes.references: Autodesk BIM 360 – 3D Modeling; CAD Drawing Standards

attributes.name: heavyjob_cost_center
attributes.description: The cost center identifier in HCSS HeavyJob associated with this work front. Used for field-level cost allocation, equipment hour tracking, and production rate reporting.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob – Cost Coding; HCSS HeavyJob – Equipment Hours

attributes.name: hse_risk_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Risk Level
attributes.description: The assessed HSE risk level for this work front based on the activities being performed, proximity to hazards, and environmental conditions. Drives frequency of safety inspections and toolbox meetings (TBM) requirements.

tag_set.value: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Risk Level

attributes.name: is_critical_path
attributes.description: Indicates whether this work front contains activities on the project critical path as determined by the CPM schedule in Oracle Primavera P6. Critical path work fronts receive priority resource allocation and daily progress monitoring.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Activity Planning; CPM Scheduling Standards

attributes.name: is_subcontracted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the work at this work front is executed by a subcontractor rather than the general contractor's own workforce. Drives subcontractor management workflows and contract administration processes.
attributes.references: Procore – Change Orders; SAP S/4HANA – Materials Management

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this work front record was most recently modified. Used for incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 – Record Control; Databricks Lakehouse – Silver Layer Conventions

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: GPS latitude coordinate of the work front centroid or reference point in decimal degrees (WGS84). Enables spatial aggregation and GIS-based reporting of production and progress data.
attributes.references: Autodesk BIM 360 – Field Management; GIS Standards (WGS84)

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: GPS longitude coordinate of the work front centroid or reference point in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used alongside latitude for spatial mapping and IoT sensor integration.
attributes.references: Autodesk BIM 360 – Field Management; GIS Standards (WGS84)

attributes.name: mobilization_date
attributes.description: The date on which resources (crew, equipment, materials) were first mobilized to this work front and active work commenced. Marks the start of the work front lifecycle for scheduling and cost tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Baseline Management; HCSS HeavyJob – Equipment Hours

attributes.name: percent_complete
attributes.description: Current physical percent complete of all planned work at this work front, expressed as a value between 0.00 and 100.00. Sourced from field progress measurements and used as input to earned value computation in the project domain.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Progress Tracking; EVM Standards (ANSI/EIA-748)

attributes.name: planned_crew_size
attributes.description: The planned number of direct labour workers assigned to this work front per shift as defined in the resource-loaded schedule. Used for crew density analysis and productivity benchmarking.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob – Time Tracking; Oracle Primavera P6 – Resource Assignment

attributes.name: planned_finish_date
attributes.description: Baseline-scheduled finish date for all work activities at this work front as defined in the project schedule. Used for schedule performance index (SPI) calculation and look-ahead planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Baseline Management; EVM Standards (ANSI/EIA-748)

attributes.name: planned_production_qty
attributes.description: Total planned production quantity for this work front expressed in the production_unit. Derived from the Bill of Quantities (BOQ) and used as the budget quantity for earned value computation.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob – Production Tracking; BOQ Standards; EVM Standards (ANSI/EIA-748)

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Baseline-scheduled start date for work activities at this work front as defined in the project schedule (Oracle Primavera P6). Used for schedule variance analysis and earned value computation.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Baseline Management; EVM Standards (ANSI/EIA-748)

attributes.name: procore_location_reference
attributes.description: The location identifier assigned to this work front in the Procore construction management system. Used to link daily logs, RFIs, submittals, and change orders to the correct spatial location.
attributes.references: Procore – Field Management; Procore – Daily Logs

attributes.name: production_unit
attributes.description: The primary unit of measure used to track production output at this work front (e.g., 'm3' for earthworks, 'LM' for piling, 'm2' for formwork, 'tonnes' for steel erection). Aligns with the Bill of Quantities (BOQ) unit for earned value computation.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob – Production Tracking; BOQ Standards; EVM Standards (ANSI/EIA-748)

attributes.name: shift_pattern
attributes.description: The shift working pattern applied at this work front. Determines daily productive hours available for scheduling and cost rate calculations.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob – Time Tracking; SAP SuccessFactors – Workforce Planning

attributes.name: weather_sensitivity
attributes.description: Classification of how sensitive the work activities at this work front are to adverse weather conditions. 'high' sensitivity work fronts (e.g., concrete pours, earthworks) require weather monitoring and contingency planning.
attributes.references: Procore – Daily Logs; ACI 305R (Hot Weather Concreting); ACI 306R (Cold Weather Concreting)

attributes.name: zone_classification
attributes.description: Discipline-based classification of the work front zone indicating the primary trade or engineering discipline active at this location. Supports resource planning and subcontractor assignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: civil|structural|mep|architectural|earthworks|piling|finishing|commissioning — promote to reference product]

products.name: daily_log
products.description: Official daily site log (header + line-item structure) capturing all field activities for a given project site and date. The header records weather conditions (temperature, precipitation, wind), site access status, manpower headcount by trade, equipment on site, work performed narrative, superintendent sign-off, and overall site status. Embedded line-item events capture each notable occurrence including delay events, weather stoppages, utility strikes, design holds, access restrictions, and safety observations — each with event type, start/end time, duration, affected work fronts, root cause classification, responsible party, and EOT/cost impact flags. This is the SSOT for all site event data — no separate event entity exists. Sourced from Procore Daily Logs module. Serves as the legal and operational record of site activity and the primary evidence base for delay claims and EOT substantiation.

attributes.name: daily_log_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the daily site log record. Primary key for the daily_log data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Daily logs are billed to the governing contract; linking enables cost allocation and compliance reporting per agreement.

attributes.name: drawing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.drawing. Business justification: Daily Log reports reference the specific design drawing used for the day's work; required for progress audit and compliance.

attributes.name: ncr_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.ncr. Business justification: Daily logs record ncr_raised_flag indicating an NCR was raised that day. Linking daily_log to quality.ncr enables QA managers to trace non-conformances to the exact day's site conditions, crew, and ac

attributes.name: phase_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.phase. Business justification: Daily logs are associated with a project phase for phase-level reporting and gate review documentation. Construction superintendents file daily logs within a phase context; phase-level log aggregation

attributes.name: site_construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical construction site or work front location where this daily log was recorded. Supports multi-site project tracking.
attributes.references: Procore Daily Logs Module; HCSS HeavyJob

attributes.name: superintendent_craft_worker_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.craft_worker. Business justification: Daily logs require an identified superintendent (craft_worker) for contractual sign-off and regulatory compliance. superintendent_sign_off_timestamp exists but the responsible person is unlinked. Paym

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the daily log was formally approved by the project manager or designated reviewer. Marks the transition from submitted to approved status in the log lifecycle.
attributes.references: Procore Daily Logs Module; ISO 9001 Document Control

attributes.name: concrete_volume_m3
attributes.description: Total volume of concrete poured on site for the log date in cubic metres. Critical production metric for structural progress tracking, QA/QC compliance (ITP), and earned value computation. Sourced from Procore and HCSS HeavyJob.
attributes.references: ACI 301 (Specifications for Structural Concrete); ITP (Inspection and Test Plan); HCSS HeavyJob

attributes.name: cost_code
attributes.description: HCSS HeavyJob cost code assigned to the primary work activity recorded in this daily log. Enables direct integration between field production data and job costing in Viewpoint Vista and SAP S/4HANA Project Systems.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob (Cost Coding); Viewpoint Vista (Job Costing); SAP S/4HANA Project Systems

attributes.name: cost_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any event recorded in this daily log has been flagged as having a potential cost impact requiring a Change Order (CO) or variation claim. True triggers cost impact assessment and contract administration workflow.
attributes.references: FIDIC Clause 13 (Variations); Procore Change Orders; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this daily log record was first created in the system. Audit trail timestamp for data lineage and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); ISO 9001 Records Management

attributes.name: direct_labour_count
attributes.description: Number of direct (GC-employed) workers on site for the log date, excluding subcontractor personnel. Used for workforce planning, payroll reconciliation, and labour productivity benchmarking.

attributes.name: earthworks_volume_m3
attributes.description: Total volume of earthworks (cut, fill, or excavation) completed on site for the log date in cubic metres. Key production quantity for earned value computation, BOQ progress measurement, and HCSS HeavyJob production tracking.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob (Production Tracking); EVM (Earned Value Management); BOQ (Bill of Quantities)

attributes.name: eot_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any event recorded in this daily log has been flagged as having a potential Extension of Time (EOT) impact on the project programme. True initiates EOT substantiation documentation under FIDIC Clause 8.4 or applicable contract conditions.
attributes.references: FIDIC Clause 8.4 (Extension of Time); Procore Daily Logs Module

attributes.name: equipment_count
attributes.description: Total number of major equipment units (plant and machinery) present and operational on site for the log date. Used for equipment utilisation tracking, cost coding in HCSS HeavyJob, and mobilisation/demobilisation records.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob (Equipment Hours); Viewpoint Vista (Equipment Management)

attributes.name: event_count
attributes.description: Total number of embedded line-item events (delay events, weather stoppages, utility strikes, design holds, access restrictions, safety observations) recorded within this daily log header. Supports event density analytics and claim complexity assessment.
attributes.references: Procore Daily Logs Module; FIDIC Clause 20 (Claims)

attributes.name: has_delay_event
attributes.description: Indicates whether one or more delay events were recorded in the embedded line-item events for this daily log. True triggers downstream delay analysis workflows and EOT claim tracking. Key filter for delay analytics.
attributes.references: FIDIC Clause 8.4 (Extension of Time); Procore Daily Logs Module

attributes.name: has_safety_observation
attributes.description: Indicates whether one or more HSE safety observations or incidents were recorded in the embedded line-item events for this daily log. True triggers integration with Intelex HSE management for incident reporting and corrective action workflows.

attributes.name: hcss_log_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this daily log to the corresponding field operations record in HCSS HeavyJob. Supports production tracking reconciliation and cost code validation between Procore and HCSS.

attributes.name: log_date
attributes.description: The calendar date for which this daily site log records field activities. The principal business event date — one log per project site per calendar day. Drives schedule performance and delay analysis.
attributes.references: Procore Daily Logs Module; FIDIC Clause 8 (Programme)

attributes.name: log_number
attributes.description: Externally-known sequential log number assigned by the construction management system (Procore) for this daily log. Used as the human-readable business identifier in correspondence, delay claims, and EOT substantiation. Format: DL-{ProjectCode}-{Year}-{Sequence}.
attributes.references: Procore Daily Logs Module; FIDIC Clause 20 (Claims)

attributes.name: log_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the daily log record. Draft indicates in-progress field entry; submitted indicates superintendent sign-off pending review; approved indicates accepted by project management; rejected indicates returned for correction; void indicates cancelled/superseded entry.

attributes.name: lti_occurred_flag

attributes.name: is_milestone
attributes.description: Indicates whether the WBS activity associated with this progress measurement is a contract or schedule milestone (True) or a regular work activity (False). Milestone completion triggers contractual notifications and potential payment events.
attributes.references: FIDIC Contract Standards; Oracle Primavera P6

attributes.name: measurement_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the physical field progress measurement was taken by the field engineer or surveyor. This is the principal real-world event date used for EVM period calculations and schedule reconciliation.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 Progress Tracking; ASCE Standards

attributes.name: measurement_method
attributes.description: The technique used to determine the percent complete or installed quantity in the field. Drives confidence weighting in EVM calculations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: visual_estimate|quantity_survey|milestone_completion|3d_scan_comparison|weighted_steps|engineering_estimate — promote to reference product if additional methods are added]
attributes.references: ASCE; PMI Earned Value Management Standard; ISO 9001

attributes.name: measurement_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for the field engineer to record observations, constraints, or qualifications relevant to the progress measurement (e.g., partial pour due to rain, access restriction, rework in progress). Supports contextual interpretation of progress data.

attributes.name: measurement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for this progress measurement record, typically formatted as a sequential reference number (e.g., FPM-2024-00123) used in Procore daily logs and field management reports.

attributes.name: measurement_period_type
attributes.description: The reporting frequency or period type for this progress measurement (e.g., daily, weekly, monthly). Determines how the measurement aligns with project reporting cycles and EVM period cut-offs in Oracle Primavera P6.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6; PMI Earned Value Management Standard

attributes.name: period_installed_quantity
attributes.description: The incremental quantity of work physically installed during the current measurement period only (not cumulative). Used for production rate tracking and period-over-period productivity analysis in HCSS HeavyJob.

attributes.name: planned_quantity
attributes.description: The total planned or budgeted quantity for the WBS activity or BOQ line item as per the approved schedule and BOQ. Used as the denominator for quantity-based percent complete calculations and production rate analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6; FIDIC Contract Standards

attributes.name: previous_percent_complete
attributes.description: The cumulative percent complete recorded in the immediately preceding measurement period for the same WBS activity or BOQ line item. Used to compute the incremental progress delta and validate that progress is monotonically increasing.
attributes.references: PMI Earned Value Management Standard; Oracle Primavera P6

attributes.name: progress_delta
attributes.description: The incremental percent complete gained in this measurement period, calculated as reported_percent_complete minus previous_percent_complete. Represents the period productivity for the activity and is used in period-based EVM reporting.
attributes.references: PMI Earned Value Management Standard; ASCE

attributes.name: quantity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure applicable to the installed_quantity field (e.g., m3 for concrete, lm for linear metres of pipe, tonne for structural steel). Must align with the BOQ line item unit of measure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: m3|m2|lm|tonne|kg|nr|ls|hr|m — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FIDIC Contract Standards; ISO 80000 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the approver when a field progress measurement is rejected (approval_status = rejected). Documents the basis for rejection to guide the field engineer in correcting and resubmitting the measurement.

attributes.name: reported_percent_complete
attributes.description: The cumulative percent complete for the WBS activity or BOQ line item as physically measured and reported by the field engineer at the time of this measurement. Expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00). This is the ground-truth value used to compute BCWP in EVM.
attributes.references: PMI Earned Value Management Standard; Oracle Primavera P6

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential revision counter for this field progress measurement record. Increments each time the measurement is revised and resubmitted after rejection. Enables version tracking and audit trail of measurement history.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Document Control; Procore Workflow Approvals

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the field engineer submitted the progress measurement record for review and approval. Used to track measurement reporting timeliness and workflow cycle time.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this field progress measurement record was last modified. Supports incremental data loading in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer and audit trail requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: The prevailing weather condition on site at the time of the field progress measurement. Used to contextualise productivity rates and support EOT (Extension of Time) claims where adverse weather impacted progress. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clear|cloudy|rain|heavy_rain|storm|snow|fog|extreme_heat — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FIDIC Contract Standards; Procore Daily Logs

products.name: site_mobilization
products.description: Master record tracking the mobilization and demobilization lifecycle of a construction site or major work package. Captures planned mobilization date, actual mobilization date, NTP (Notice to Proceed) date, site establishment milestones (fencing, laydown area, site office, utilities), demobilization plan date, actual demobilization date, and site closure sign-off. Provides the temporal and logistical anchor for all site operations.

attributes.name: site_mobilization_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the site mobilization record. Primary key for the site_mobilization data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: account_id

attributes.name: agreement_id

attributes.name: asset_id

attributes.name: cash_flow_forecast_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cash_flow_forecast. Business justification: Mobilization timing (planned/actual dates, peak workforce) is a primary driver of early-project cash outflows. Cash flow forecasts include payroll_amount, equipment_hire_amount, and material_procureme

attributes.name: client_contact_id

attributes.name: hse_plan_id

attributes.name: phase_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.phase. Business justification: Site mobilization is executed within a specific project phase (e.g., Mobilization Phase, Construction Phase). Phase-based mobilization tracking is required for phase gate reviews, phase-level cost rep

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.quality_plan. Business justification: Site mobilization requires a quality plan to be approved before work commences — a standard construction contract and ISO 9001 requirement. Linking site_mobilization to quality_plan enables project ma

attributes.description: Activity identifier from Oracle Primavera P6 corresponding to the mobilization WBS activity. Enables direct traceability between this mobilization record and the project schedule baseline.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Activity Planning; WBS (Work Breakdown Structure) Standard

attributes.name: project_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.project_budget. Business justification: Site mobilization has cost_budget and cost_actual attributes but no link to the formal project budget record. Mobilization is a distinct budget line item in construction contracts. This link enables b

attributes.name: rfq_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.rfq. Business justification: Mobilization procurement chain traceability: mobilization services (site establishment, temporary utilities) are procured via RFQ process. Procurement managers need to trace mobilization scope from RF

attributes.name: schedule_milestone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to schedule.schedule_milestone. Business justification: NTP, site establishment, and demobilization are contractual schedule milestones tied directly to mobilization events. Contract administrators track milestone achievement (LD exposure, payment certific

attributes.name: subcontract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.subcontract. Business justification: A subcontractor mobilization is authorized by a specific subcontract, not just the head agreement. Linking site_mobilization to the governing subcontract enables subcontractor mobilization compliance

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.procurement_framework_agreement. Business justification: REQUIRED: Mobilisation activities are often covered under a framework agreement with a vendor; linking enables compliance and spend tracking.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.wbs_element. Business justification: Site mobilization activities are tracked against WBS elements for cost and schedule control. wbs_code is a denormalized text representation of the WBS FK. Linking mobilization to WBS elements enables

attributes.name: access_road_established
attributes.description: Indicates whether the primary site access road and entry/exit gates have been constructed and are operational for heavy vehicle and workforce ingress/egress.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1926.601 – Motor Vehicles; ASCE Infrastructure Standards

attributes.name: actual_demobilization_date
attributes.description: Date on which site demobilization was physically completed and the site was vacated. Compared against planned_demobilization_date to assess demobilization schedule performance.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Actual Finish; FIDIC Conditions of Contract – Clause 11

attributes.name: actual_mobilization_date
attributes.description: Date on which site mobilization physically commenced (first crew or equipment on site). Compared against planned_mobilization_date to compute mobilization schedule variance.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Actual Start; Procore Daily Logs

attributes.name: building_permit_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the building or construction permit issued by the local authority. Required before commencement of structural works and tracked for regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: IBC International Building Code Council; Local Authority Building Regulations

attributes.name: cost_actual
attributes.description: Actual costs incurred for site mobilization activities as recorded in the job costing system (Viewpoint Vista / SAP S/4HANA). Used for cost variance analysis against mobilization_cost_budget.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems – Actual Costs; Viewpoint Vista – Job Costing

attributes.name: cost_budget
attributes.description: Approved budget allocated for site mobilization activities including site establishment, temporary facilities, equipment transport, and initial workforce deployment. Expressed in the project currency.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems – Cost Planning; Viewpoint Vista – Job Costing

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country in which the construction site is located (e.g., USA, AUS, GBR, ARE). Drives regulatory compliance framework selection and reporting jurisdiction.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Country Codes; FIDIC Conditions of Contract – Governing Law

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this site mobilization record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date and Time Standard; GDPR Article 5 – Data Integrity and Accountability

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary values on this mobilization record (e.g., USD, AUD, GBP, AED). Ensures consistent financial reporting across multi-currency international projects.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: dlp_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Defects Liability Period (DLP) for site establishment works expires. After this date, the contractor is no longer obligated to rectify defects in temporary site infrastructure.
attributes.references: FIDIC Conditions of Contract – Clause 11; Internal Contract Administration Standard

attributes.name: environmental_permit_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the primary environmental permit issued by the regulatory authority (e.g., EPA NPDES permit number). Required for regulatory compliance tracking and audit.
attributes.references: EPA Environmental Protection Agency – NPDES; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems

attributes.name: environmental_permit_obtained
attributes.description: Indicates whether all required environmental permits and approvals (e.g., EPA stormwater NPDES permit, land disturbance permit) have been obtained prior to ground disturbance.
attributes.references: EPA Environmental Protection Agency – NPDES Permit; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: hse_plan_approval_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Plan Approval Date
attributes.description: Date on which the site HSE plan was formally approved by the HSE Manager and client representative. Required for regulatory compliance and Intelex HSE management system records.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety; Intelex HSE Management – Permit to Work

tag_set.value: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Plan Approval Date

attributes.name: hse_plan_approved
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Plan Approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether the site-specific HSE plan has been reviewed and approved prior to mobilization commencement. Mandatory pre-mobilization gate per ISO 45001 and OSHA requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety; OSHA 29 CFR 1926 – Safety and Health Regulations

tag_set.value: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Plan Approved

attributes.name: laydown_area_established
attributes.description: Indicates whether the designated materials laydown and storage area has been prepared, demarcated, and made operational for receiving deliveries and storing equipment.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob – Field Operations; OSHA 29 CFR 1926.250 – Materials Storage

attributes.name: leed_certification_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) Certification Target
attributes.description: Target LEED certification level for the project site as specified in the contract or client brief. Influences site establishment requirements for waste management, stormwater control, and sustainable practices.
attributes.references: LEED U.S. Green Building Council; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems

tag_set.value: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) Certification Target

attributes.name: mobilization_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this mobilization record, used in correspondence, Procore daily logs, and Aconex transmittals. Follows the enterprise MOB-XXXXXX numbering convention.
attributes.references: Procore Construction Management – Daily Logs; Aconex Document Management

attributes.name: mobilization_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the site mobilization record: planned (NTP received, not yet started), in_progress (site establishment underway), completed (fully mobilized and operational), demobilized (site closed and handed back), cancelled (mobilization voided), on_hold (temporarily suspended).
attributes.references: Procore Construction Management – Site Setup; FIDIC Conditions of Contract

attributes.name: mobilization_type
attributes.description: Classification of the mobilization scope: full_site (complete site establishment), work_package (specific WBS package), temporary_camp (workforce accommodation), equipment_only (plant and machinery deployment), or partial (phased mobilization). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: full_site|work_package|temporary_camp|equipment_only|partial|phased — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FIDIC Conditions of Contract – Clause 2; Internal Site Operations Standard

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, constraints, special conditions, or observations related to the site mobilization that are not captured in structured fields (e.g., access restrictions, community liaison requirements).
attributes.references: Procore Construction Management – Daily Logs; Aconex Document Management

attributes.name: ntp_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Notice to Proceed (NTP) was issued by the client or engineer, authorizing the contractor to commence site mobilization and construction activities. Critical contractual milestone.
attributes.references: FIDIC Conditions of Contract – Clause 8.1; AIA A201 General Conditions

attributes.name: peak_workforce_actual
attributes.description: Maximum number of workers (direct and subcontractor) actually recorded on site simultaneously during the mobilization period, as tracked in HCSS HeavyJob time records.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob – Time Tracking; OSHA 29 CFR 1926 – Worker Count Records

attributes.name: peak_workforce_planned
attributes.description: Maximum number of workers (direct and subcontractor) planned to be on site simultaneously at peak mobilization, as per the resource-loaded schedule in Oracle Primavera P6.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Resource Assignment; SAP SuccessFactors – Workforce Planning

attributes.name: planned_demobilization_date
attributes.description: Baseline-scheduled date on which site demobilization was planned to be completed, as per the approved project schedule. Used for resource release planning and contract completion forecasting.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Baseline Schedule; FIDIC Conditions of Contract – Clause 11

attributes.name: planned_mobilization_date
attributes.description: Baseline-scheduled date on which site mobilization activities were planned to commence, as recorded in Oracle Primavera P6. Used for schedule variance analysis and earned value management (EVM).
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Baseline Schedule; PMBOK Guide – Schedule Management

attributes.name: procore_project_reference
attributes.description: External system identifier for this site in Procore Construction Management platform. Used for cross-system reconciliation of daily logs, RFIs, and field management records.
attributes.references: Procore Construction Management – Project Setup; Internal System Integration Standard

attributes.name: schedule_variance_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days difference between actual_mobilization_date and planned_mobilization_date. Positive value indicates delay; negative value indicates early mobilization. Used for schedule performance reporting.
attributes.references: EVM (Earned Value Management) – SPI (Schedule Performance Index); Oracle Primavera P6

attributes.name: site_address
attributes.description: Physical street address or location description of the construction site. Used for logistics coordination, regulatory notifications, and emergency response planning.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1926.16 – Contractor Responsibilities; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: site_area_sqm
attributes.description: Total area of the construction site in square metres as defined in the site establishment plan. Used for site logistics planning, laydown area allocation, and HSE zone management.
attributes.references: IBC International Building Code; OSHA 29 CFR 1926 – Construction Safety

attributes.name: site_closure_signoff_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal site closure sign-off was completed by the client, engineer, and contractor, confirming all demobilization obligations have been fulfilled and the site has been restored.
attributes.references: FIDIC Conditions of Contract – Clause 11.11; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: site_fencing_complete
attributes.description: Indicates whether site perimeter fencing and hoarding have been fully erected as part of site establishment. Key safety milestone required before workforce deployment.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1926.502 – Fall Protection; IBC International Building Code

attributes.name: site_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the construction site centroid in decimal degrees (WGS84). Supports GIS-based site mapping, logistics routing, and spatial analytics.
attributes.references: GIS (Geographic Information System) Standards – WGS84; ASCE 7 Site Classification

attributes.name: site_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the construction site centroid in decimal degrees (WGS84). Supports GIS-based site mapping, logistics routing, and spatial analytics.
attributes.references: GIS (Geographic Information System) Standards – WGS84; ASCE 7 Site Classification

attributes.name: site_office_established
attributes.description: Indicates whether the temporary site office (including communications, IT infrastructure, and welfare facilities) has been established and is operational.
attributes.references: Procore Construction Management – Site Setup; OSHA 29 CFR 1926.51 – Sanitation

attributes.name: temporary_utilities_connected
attributes.description: Indicates whether temporary site utilities (power, water, telecommunications, sewage) have been connected and are operational. Prerequisite for sustained site operations.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1926.403 – Electrical Safety; NFPA 70E Electrical Safety Standard

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this site mobilization record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change tracking, incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date and Time Standard; GDPR Article 5 – Data Integrity and Accountability

products.name: equipment_deployment
products.description: Daily or period-based record of construction equipment deployed to a specific work front or activity on site. Captures equipment ID (FK to equipment domain), deployment date, release date, operating hours, idle hours, cost code, operator name, fuel consumption, and breakdown flag. Sourced from HCSS HeavyJob equipment hours module. Distinct from equipment domain master records — this entity tracks the operational utilization of equipment at the site level.

attributes.name: equipment_deployment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each equipment deployment record in the site domain. Primary key for the equipment_deployment data product.

attributes.name: activity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the scheduled activity or Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element in the project schedule to which this equipment deployment is assigned.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 — Activity Record; WBS (Work Breakdown Structure)

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the equipment master record in the equipment domain. Identifies the specific piece of construction equipment (e.g., excavator, crane, compactor) deployed to site.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance — Equipment Master

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the project master record. Links the equipment deployment to the construction project under which the equipment is being utilized.

attributes.name: cost_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.cost_account. Business justification: Equipment deployment costs are charged to cost accounts for equipment cost control and EVM. Standard construction project controls requirement — equipment hours and costs must be posted to cost accoun

attributes.name: estimate_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to bid.estimate_line. Business justification: Construction cost controllers compare actual equipment hours and costs (equipment_deployment) against estimated equipment allowances (estimate_line) to produce plant cost variance reports — a standard

attributes.name: finance_cost_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_code. Business justification: Equipment usage charges are posted to finance cost codes; linking enables equipment cost reporting and asset depreciation.

attributes.name: fleet_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to equipment.fleet_assignment. Business justification: Daily equipment deployment records execute against a formal fleet assignment. Project controls and equipment utilization reporting require linking each deployment event to its governing fleet assignme

attributes.name: hcss_equipment_hours_id
attributes.description: The source system record identifier from HCSS HeavyJob equipment hours module. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and incremental load processing from the operational system of record.

attributes.name: inspection_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to equipment.inspection_record. Business justification: Pre-start inspection compliance is a mandatory HSE requirement before deploying equipment on site. Linking deployment to the current inspection_record enables verification that equipment passed pre-de

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.job_cost_transaction. Each deployment generates a job cost transaction for hire or ownership cost

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.craft_worker. Business justification: equipment_deployment stores operator_name and operator_license_number as plain text. Regulatory compliance requires verifying operator certifications against equipment type. Linking to craft_worker en

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.permit_to_work. Business justification: Equipment deployments (cranes, excavators, elevated work platforms) require specific permits to work before operation. 'hse_permit_number' is a denormalized text reference to the permit_to_work entity

attributes.name: phase_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.phase. Business justification: Equipment deployment is planned by phase for resource scheduling and phase-level equipment cost reporting. Construction project controls require phase-level equipment tracking for EVM and phase gate r

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.po_line. Business justification: Equipment rental invoice line matching: equipment rental POs have line items per equipment type/period. Linking deployment to the specific PO line enables precise three-way match at line level for cos

attributes.description: Reference identifier of the Procore daily log entry from which this equipment deployment record was sourced. Enables traceability back to the source construction management system.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: REQUIRED: Equipment rental or purchase orders are linked to each deployment for cost allocation and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: rental_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to equipment.rental_agreement. Business justification: Rental equipment deployments must be reconciled against the rental agreement for invoice validation and cost accrual. rental_order_number is a denormalized text field; a proper FK to rental_agreement

attributes.name: rental_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Equipment rental vendor tracking: equipment_deployment.supplier_name is a denormalized vendor reference. Plant managers and accounts payable need the rental vendor FK for invoice verification, rental

attributes.name: shift_report_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to site.shift_report. Business justification: An equipment deployment record tracks equipment used during a specific shift. The shift_report summarizes all equipment deployed in that shift (equipment_count, equipment_utilisation_pct). Linking equ

attributes.name: work_front_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific work front or work zone on site where the equipment is deployed. A work front represents a distinct area of concurrent construction activity.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob — Cost Code / Work Front

attributes.name: breakdown_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the nature of the equipment breakdown or mechanical failure, as recorded by the site supervisor or equipment operator. Populated only when breakdown_flag is True.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob — Equipment Notes; SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance — Notification

attributes.name: breakdown_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the equipment experienced a mechanical breakdown or unplanned failure during this deployment period. True = breakdown occurred; False = no breakdown. Triggers maintenance workflow in SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob — Equipment Breakdown Flag; SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance

attributes.name: breakdown_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours the equipment was unavailable due to mechanical breakdown or unplanned maintenance during the shift or reporting period. Feeds into equipment reliability and maintenance KPI reporting.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob — Equipment Hours Module; SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the hourly rate and cost values recorded in this deployment record (e.g., USD, AUD, GBP, AED).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; IFRS/GAAP — Financial Reporting

attributes.name: deployment_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the equipment was mobilized and deployed to the designated work front or activity. Represents the start of the deployment period for daily or period-based tracking.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob — Equipment Hours Module; Procore — Daily Log

attributes.name: deployment_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for this equipment deployment record, as assigned in HCSS HeavyJob or the site daily log system. Used for cross-system traceability and field reporting.

attributes.name: deployment_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the equipment deployment record. 'active' indicates equipment is in productive use; 'idle' indicates on-site but not producing; 'breakdown' indicates mechanical failure; 'demobilized' indicates equipment has left site; 'standby' indicates awaiting assignment; 'transferred' indicates moved to another work front or project.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob — Equipment Status; ISO 9001 — Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: equipment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the equipment by functional category (e.g., Excavator, Bulldozer, Crane, Compactor, Concrete Pump, Dump Truck, Grader). Sourced from the equipment master but denormalized here for site-level reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: excavator|bulldozer|crane|compactor|concrete_pump|dump_truck|grader|loader|paver|roller|generator|pump|forklift|drill_rig — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob — Equipment Classification; SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance

attributes.name: fuel_consumption_liters
attributes.description: Total fuel consumed by the equipment during the shift or reporting period, measured in liters. Used for cost tracking, environmental reporting, and fuel efficiency benchmarking.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob — Fuel Tracking; ISO 14001 — Environmental Monitoring; EPA — Fuel Consumption Reporting

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: Type of fuel consumed by the equipment. Used for environmental emissions reporting and fuel cost categorization.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 — Environmental Management; EPA — Emissions Reporting

attributes.name: hourly_rate
attributes.description: The contracted or internal charge rate for the equipment per operating hour, in the project currency. Used for job costing and cost-to-complete calculations. Confidential as it reflects commercial pricing.
attributes.references: Viewpoint Vista — Equipment Rate; FIDIC — Equipment Rates Schedule

attributes.name: idle_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours the equipment was on-site but not in productive operation (e.g., waiting for materials, weather delays, operator breaks). Idle hours are tracked separately from operating hours for utilization analysis.

attributes.name: operating_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours the equipment was in productive operation during the shift or reporting period. Used for earned value computation, equipment cost allocation, and maintenance scheduling.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob — Equipment Hours Module; EVM (Earned Value Management)

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the deployed equipment is company-owned, rented from an external supplier, leased under a finance or operating lease, or provided by a subcontractor. Affects cost coding and financial treatment.
