products.name: vendor
products.description: Master record for all approved and prospective suppliers, subcontractors, and material vendors managed via SAP MM Vendor Master. Captures vendor identity, classification (material supplier, equipment rental, specialist subcontractor), registration status, tax identifiers, payment terms, currency, bank details, geographic coverage, diversity classification (MBE/WBE/DBE), bonding capacity, insurance certificates, and SAP vendor account number. SSOT for vendor identity across the procurement domain.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor record. Primary key for the vendor master data product. System-generated surrogate key used across all procurement and supply chain transactions.

attributes.name: firm_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to bid.firm_profile. Business justification: Vendor master must reference firm firm profile for prequalification, compliance reporting, and to identify firm vendors.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: SAP vendor account number assigned in SAP MM Vendor Master. External business identifier used in purchase orders, invoices, and payment processing. Unique across the ERP system.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: First line of the vendor's registered business address. Typically contains street number and street name. Used for correspondence, legal notices, and payment remittance.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Second line of the vendor's business address. Contains suite, floor, building, or other secondary address information. Nullable if not applicable.

attributes.name: annual_revenue_amount
attributes.description: Vendor's reported annual revenue in the vendor's default currency. Used for vendor size classification, capacity assessment, and financial stability evaluation. Typically self-reported or obtained from financial statements.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor was approved for procurement transactions following successful completion of prequalification, due diligence, and compliance checks. Nullable for prospective vendors not yet approved.

attributes.name: audit_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the most recent vendor audit. Passed indicates full compliance; passed with conditions indicates minor findings requiring corrective action; failed indicates major non-conformances; not audited indicates no audit has been conducted.

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: Vendor's bank account number for electronic payment receipt. Highly sensitive financial information used for ACH and wire transfer processing. Encrypted at rest and in transit.

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution where the vendor maintains their primary business account for payment receipt. Used for electronic payment processing and wire transfers.

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: Bank routing number, SWIFT code, or IBAN for the vendor's bank account. Used to route electronic payments to the correct financial institution. Format varies by country and payment network.

attributes.name: bonding_capacity_amount
attributes.description: Maximum bonding capacity available to the vendor in the vendor's default currency. Represents the total value of performance bonds and payment bonds the vendor can secure from their surety. Critical for subcontractor prequalification and large contract awards.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the vendor's registered business address is located. Used for geographic analysis, local sourcing initiatives, and logistics planning.

attributes.name: classification
attributes.description: Primary business classification of the vendor based on the type of goods or services provided. Determines procurement workflows, approval hierarchies, and contract templates. Material suppliers provide construction materials; equipment rental provides machinery; specialist subcontractors perform MEP, civil, or structural work; general contractors manage construction execution; professional services include design, engineering, and consulting; utility providers supply power, water, and telecommunications.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the vendor's registered business location. Used for international trade compliance, currency determination, and cross-border procurement regulations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and vendor relationship tenure analysis. System-generated and immutable.

attributes.name: credit_rating
attributes.description: Credit rating assigned by credit rating agencies (Dun & Bradstreet, Moody's, S&P) reflecting the vendor's financial stability and creditworthiness. Used for vendor risk assessment and payment term determination. NR indicates not rated. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: aaa|aa|a|bbb|bb|b|ccc|cc|c|d|nr — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the vendor's default transaction currency. Determines the currency used for purchase orders, invoices, and payments. Used for foreign exchange exposure analysis.

attributes.name: diversity_classification
attributes.description: Diversity certification status for the vendor. MBE (Minority Business Enterprise), WBE (Women Business Enterprise), DBE (Disadvantaged Business Enterprise), SDVOSB (Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business), HUBZone (Historically Underutilized Business Zone). Used for diversity spend reporting and compliance with client diversity requirements.

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit DUNS number issued by Dun & Bradstreet for unique identification of business entities. Used for credit checks, vendor risk assessment, and compliance with government contracting requirements.

attributes.name: employee_count
attributes.description: Total number of employees working for the vendor organization. Used for vendor capacity assessment, small business classification, and resource availability evaluation.

attributes.name: geographic_coverage
attributes.description: Geographic regions or markets where the vendor operates and can provide services. Free-text field listing countries, states, or regions. Used for project-specific vendor selection and logistics planning.

attributes.name: insurance_certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate number for the vendor's current general liability and professional indemnity insurance policy. Used to verify insurance coverage before contract execution and during vendor compliance audits.

attributes.name: insurance_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the vendor's current insurance certificate. Monitored to ensure continuous insurance coverage throughout the contract period. Triggers renewal reminders and compliance alerts.

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent vendor audit or compliance review. Audits assess quality systems, safety practices, financial controls, and contract compliance. Used to schedule periodic re-audits and maintain vendor qualification status.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the vendor master record. Used for change tracking, data quality monitoring, and synchronization with downstream systems.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the vendor organization as registered with tax authorities. Used on contracts, purchase orders, and payment documents. Must match legal registration documents.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Preferred payment method for remitting payment to the vendor. ACH for automated clearing house electronic transfer; wire transfer for same-day international payments; check for traditional paper payments; credit card for small purchases; letter of credit for international trade.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Standard payment terms code defining the payment schedule and discount structure for this vendor. Examples include NET30 (net 30 days), NET60, 2/10NET30 (2% discount if paid within 10 days, otherwise net 30). Drives accounts payable processing and cash flow planning.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the vendor's business address. Used for mail delivery, logistics planning, and geographic segmentation. Format varies by country.

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this vendor has preferred vendor status. Preferred vendors receive priority consideration for bid invitations, expedited approval processes, and favorable payment terms based on proven performance and strategic relationship.

attributes.name: prequalification_score
attributes.description: Composite score from the vendor prequalification process evaluating financial stability, technical capability, safety record, quality performance, and past project experience. Scale typically 0-100. Used for vendor ranking and bid invitation decisions.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary vendor contact. Used for purchase order transmission, RFQ distribution, invoice queries, and general procurement communication.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact at the vendor organization. This individual serves as the main point of contact for procurement, contract administration, and operational coordination.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the vendor contact. Used for urgent procurement matters, delivery coordination, and issue resolution. Includes country code and extension where applicable.

attributes.name: quality_certification
attributes.description: Quality management system certifications held by the vendor. Common certifications include ISO 9001 (Quality Management), ISO 14001 (Environmental Management), ISO 45001 (Occupational Health and Safety). Multiple certifications separated by semicolons.

attributes.name: registration_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor was first registered in the vendor master system. Marks the beginning of the vendor relationship and is used for vendor tenure analysis and anniversary tracking.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region where the vendor is located. Used for tax jurisdiction determination, regional sourcing analysis, and compliance with local content requirements.

attributes.name: suspension_end_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual date when vendor suspension will be or was lifted. Nullable for indefinite suspensions or vendors that have never been suspended. Used for reinstatement planning and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Reason for vendor suspension or blocking if vendor_status is suspended or blocked. Examples include quality issues, safety violations, contract breaches, financial instability, or ethical violations. Nullable for active vendors.

attributes.name: suspension_start_date
attributes.description: Date when vendor suspension or blocking became effective. Used to track suspension duration and trigger review processes. Nullable for vendors that have never been suspended.

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: Government-issued tax identification number for the vendor. Used for tax reporting, 1099 processing, and compliance with tax regulations. Format varies by jurisdiction (EIN in USA, VAT number in EU, GST number in other regions).

attributes.name: vendor_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor in the vendor master. Approved vendors can receive purchase orders; prospective vendors are under evaluation; suspended vendors have temporary restrictions; blocked vendors cannot receive new orders; inactive vendors are no longer used; under_review vendors are being re-qualified.

products.name: vendor_qualification
products.description: Supplier pre-qualification and approved vendor list (AVL) records capturing qualification status, financial health assessments, technical capability evaluations, HSE performance ratings, quality certifications (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001), bonding limits, insurance coverage verification, past performance scores, and qualification expiry dates. Tracks the full vendor onboarding and re-qualification lifecycle required before a vendor can receive a PO.

attributes.name: vendor_qualification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor qualification record. Primary key for the vendor qualification entity.

attributes.name: skill_trade_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.skill_trade. Business justification: Vendor qualification records specify which skill trades a vendor is approved to supply. Replacing denormalized 'approved_service_types' text with a FK to skill_trade enables structured trade-level ven

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor master record being qualified. Links to the vendor entity in the procurement domain.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor qualification was formally approved and the vendor was added to the AVL (Approved Vendor List).

attributes.name: approved_material_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of material categories the vendor is qualified to supply. Examples include concrete, steel, MEP (Mechanical Electrical and Plumbing) equipment, formwork, aggregates. Aligns with MTO (Material Take-Off) classification.

attributes.name: bonding_capacity_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for bonding capacity limit. Typically USD for US-based projects.

attributes.name: bonding_capacity_limit
attributes.description: Maximum bonding capacity available from the vendor's surety company. Determines the maximum contract value the vendor can undertake. Critical for GC (General Contractor) and major subcontractor qualifications.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor qualification record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail for compliance and governance.

attributes.name: financial_health_score
attributes.description: Composite financial health assessment score ranging from 0.00 to 100.00. Based on credit rating, liquidity ratios, debt-to-equity, and financial statement analysis. Minimum threshold typically 60.00 for approval.

attributes.name: geographic_coverage
attributes.description: Geographic regions or countries where the vendor is qualified to operate. Comma-separated list of ISO 3166 country codes or region names. Important for multi-site and international projects.

attributes.name: hse_performance_rating
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Performance Rating
attributes.description: HSE (Health Safety and Environment) performance rating based on TRIR (Total Recordable Incident Rate), LTI (Lost Time Injury) frequency, safety audit results, and compliance with OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration) standards. Critical factor for vendor approval.

tag_set.value: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Performance Rating

attributes.name: insurance_certificate_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiry date of the vendor's insurance certificate. Procurement tracks this to ensure continuous coverage throughout contract execution.

attributes.name: insurance_general_liability_limit
attributes.description: General liability insurance coverage limit. Minimum requirements typically range from $1M to $10M depending on project size and risk profile.

attributes.name: insurance_workers_comp_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether valid workers compensation insurance has been verified. Mandatory for all vendors providing on-site labor per OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration) requirements.

attributes.name: iso_14001_certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate number for ISO 14001 Environmental Management System certification.

attributes.name: iso_14001_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor holds valid ISO 14001 Environmental Management System certification. Increasingly required for LEED (Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design) projects and environmentally sensitive sites.

attributes.name: iso_14001_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiry date of ISO 14001 certification. Critical for projects with EPA (Environmental Protection Agency) compliance requirements.

attributes.name: iso_45001_certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate number for ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management System certification.

attributes.name: iso_45001_certified
attributes.business_glossary_term: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor holds valid ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management System certification. Demonstrates commitment to worker safety and HSE (Health Safety and Environment) excellence.

tag_set.value: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Certified

attributes.name: iso_45001_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiry date of ISO 45001 certification. Monitored to ensure ongoing HSE (Health Safety and Environment) compliance.

attributes.name: iso_9001_certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate number for ISO 9001 Quality Management System certification. Used for verification with certification body.

attributes.name: iso_9001_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor holds valid ISO 9001 Quality Management System certification. Often mandatory for critical material suppliers and major subcontractors.

attributes.name: iso_9001_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiry date of ISO 9001 certification. Procurement monitors this to ensure vendors maintain valid certification throughout contract execution.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor qualification record was last updated. Tracks changes to qualification status, scores, certifications, or other attributes.

attributes.name: lti_frequency_rate
attributes.description: LTI (Lost Time Injury) frequency rate calculated as (number of LTIs × 1,000,000) / total hours worked. Measures severity of safety incidents. Target is typically below 1.0 for qualified vendors.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional qualification details, special conditions, limitations, or observations from the assessment process. Used by procurement team for decision support.

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of past deliveries completed on or before scheduled date. Critical metric for CPM (Critical Path Method) schedule-sensitive projects. Target is typically above 90.00%.

attributes.name: past_performance_score
attributes.description: Composite past performance score ranging from 0.00 to 100.00. Based on historical project delivery, quality, schedule adherence, cost control, and client satisfaction. Derived from completed project evaluations and NCR (Non-Conformance Report) history.

attributes.name: qualification_assessment_date
attributes.description: Date when the qualification assessment was conducted. Includes site visits, document reviews, financial analysis, and technical capability evaluation.

attributes.name: qualification_category
attributes.description: Primary category of goods or services the vendor is qualified to supply. MEP (Mechanical Electrical and Plumbing) is a specialized category for building systems contractors.

attributes.name: qualification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the vendor qualification expires and requires renewal. Typically set 1-3 years from start date depending on vendor category and risk profile.

attributes.name: qualification_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the vendor qualification record. Externally visible unique reference number used in procurement communications and AVL (Approved Vendor List) documentation.

attributes.name: qualification_start_date
attributes.description: Effective date from which the vendor qualification becomes valid. Vendors can only receive PO (Purchase Order) assignments on or after this date.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor qualification. Approved vendors are eligible for PO (Purchase Order) issuance. Suspended vendors require re-qualification. Expired qualifications require renewal.

attributes.name: qualification_type
attributes.description: Type of qualification process being conducted. Initial for new vendors, renewal for periodic re-assessment, re-qualification for vendors returning after suspension, conditional for limited-scope approval, emergency for urgent project needs.

attributes.name: quality_defect_rate
attributes.description: Historical quality defect rate expressed as percentage of deliverables requiring rework or NCR (Non-Conformance Report) issuance. Lower values indicate better quality performance. Target is typically below 5.00%.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation if the vendor qualification was rejected. Includes specific deficiencies in financial health, technical capability, HSE (Health Safety and Environment) performance, or documentation.

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor qualification was suspended. Suspended vendors cannot receive new PO (Purchase Order) assignments until re-qualified.

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Reason for suspending an approved vendor qualification. Common causes include safety incidents, quality failures, financial distress, contract breaches, or regulatory violations.

attributes.name: technical_capability_score
attributes.description: Assessment score of vendor technical capabilities ranging from 0.00 to 100.00. Evaluates equipment, workforce skills, past project complexity, and technical certifications. Minimum threshold typically 70.00 for complex EPC (Engineering Procurement and Construction) projects.

attributes.name: trir_rate
attributes.description: TRIR (Total Recordable Incident Rate) calculated as (number of recordable incidents × 200,000) / total hours worked. Industry benchmark for construction is typically below 3.0. Lower values indicate better safety performance.

products.name: material_catalog
products.description: Authoritative catalog of all procurable materials, equipment components, and consumables managed in SAP MM Material Master. Captures material number, description, material group, base unit of measure, weight, dimensions, hazardous material classification, storage conditions, lead time, minimum order quantity, standard cost, and BIM object reference. SSOT for material identity used across MTO, PO, and goods receipt processes.

attributes.name: material_catalog_id
attributes.description: Primary key for material_catalog

attributes.name: technical_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.technical_specification. Business justification: Material catalog items in construction are defined against technical specifications (piping specs, structural steel specs). 'specification_reference' is a plain-text denormalization. Linking catalog i

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: Inventory classification based on value and consumption frequency. A=High value/critical items requiring tight control, B=Moderate value, C=Low value/high volume items. Drives inventory policy and cycle counting frequency.

attributes.name: alternative_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Secondary unit of measure for materials that can be ordered or issued in multiple units (e.g., cement ordered in bags but tracked in tons). Supports conversion factor calculations.

attributes.name: base_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Primary unit of measure for material quantity tracking, ordering, and inventory management. Aligns with industry standards for construction materials (EA=Each, M=Meter, M2=Square Meter, M3=Cubic Meter, KG=Kilogram, TON=Metric Ton). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|M|M2|M3|KG|TON|L|GAL|FT|YD|LB|BAG|BOX|ROLL — 14 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: bim_object_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier linking the material to its corresponding 3D object in BIM 360 or other BIM platforms. Enables digital twin integration and clash detection during design and construction phases.

attributes.name: cost_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for standard cost (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency procurement and financial consolidation.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating where the material is manufactured or sourced. Required for customs compliance, trade regulations, and local content reporting.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when the material master record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and master data governance.

attributes.name: customs_tariff_number
attributes.description: Harmonized System (HS) code for international trade classification. Used for customs clearance, duty calculation, and import/export documentation for cross-border procurement.

attributes.name: dimension_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for length, width, and height dimensions. Typically meters (M) for construction industry standards.

attributes.name: environmental_certification
attributes.description: Environmental sustainability certification held by the material (e.g., LEED certified, FSC certified, Energy Star). Supports green building requirements and sustainability reporting.

attributes.name: gross_weight
attributes.description: Total weight of the material including packaging, measured in kilograms. Used for logistics planning, transportation cost calculation, and site delivery scheduling.

attributes.name: hazard_class
attributes.description: UN hazard classification code for hazardous materials (e.g., Class 3 Flammable Liquids, Class 8 Corrosives). Required for transportation, storage, and safety data sheet (SDS) compliance.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: hazardous_material_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the material is classified as hazardous per OSHA and EPA regulations. Triggers special handling, storage, and HSE (Health Safety and Environment) compliance requirements.

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Height dimension of the material in meters. Essential for volume calculations and warehouse stacking constraints.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last updated the material master record. Tracks data ownership and change responsibility.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when the material master record was last updated. Tracks data currency and supports change management processes.

attributes.name: length
attributes.description: Length dimension of the material in meters. Critical for structural materials (beams, pipes, cables) and storage space planning.

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary manufacturer or brand for the material. Used for quality assurance, warranty tracking, and approved vendor list (AVL) compliance.

attributes.name: manufacturer_part_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer's unique part number or model code for the material. Critical for exact specification matching, warranty claims, and spare parts procurement.

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Full textual description of the material, equipment component, or consumable item. Provides detailed specification and identification information for procurement and inventory purposes.

attributes.name: material_group
attributes.description: Classification code grouping materials by procurement category (e.g., concrete, steel, MEP equipment, PPE). Used for procurement strategy, vendor assignment, and spend analysis.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the material as defined in SAP MM Material Master. This is the externally-known code used across MTO (Material Take-Off), PO (Purchase Order), and goods receipt processes.

attributes.name: material_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the material in the catalog. Controls procurement eligibility and inventory transactions. Blocked materials cannot be ordered; obsolete materials are phased out.

attributes.name: material_type
attributes.description: SAP material type classification defining procurement and inventory control behavior. RAW=Raw Material, SEMI=Semi-Finished, FERT=Finished Product, HAWA=Trading Goods, NLAG=Non-Stock Material, UNBW=Non-Valuated Material, DIEN=Services, VERP=Packaging, HIBE=Operating Supplies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: RAW|SEMI|FERT|HAWA|NLAG|UNBW|DIEN|VERP|HIBE — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Smallest quantity that can be ordered from suppliers in base unit of measure. Drives procurement batch sizing and inventory optimization.

attributes.name: net_weight
attributes.description: Weight of the material excluding packaging, measured in kilograms. Used for material quantity verification and yield calculations in construction processes.

attributes.name: procurement_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard number of days from PO (Purchase Order) issuance to material delivery on site. Used for project scheduling, MRP (Material Requirements Planning), and critical path analysis.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether incoming goods receipt requires quality inspection per ITP (Inspection and Test Plan) before acceptance. Triggers QA/QC workflow in goods receipt process.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days the material can be stored before expiration or quality degradation. Critical for perishable materials (adhesives, sealants, chemicals) and inventory rotation (FIFO/FEFO).

attributes.name: short_description
attributes.description: Abbreviated description of the material for display in transaction screens, reports, and mobile applications. Limited to 40 characters for operational efficiency.

attributes.name: standard_cost
attributes.description: Baseline unit cost of the material used for project budgeting, cost estimation, and variance analysis. Updated periodically based on procurement history and market conditions.

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required environmental conditions for material storage to maintain quality and safety. Drives warehouse zone assignment and inventory handling procedures. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ambient|climate_controlled|refrigerated|dry|ventilated|hazmat_certified|outdoor_covered|outdoor_uncovered — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: valuation_class
attributes.description: SAP valuation class code linking material to general ledger (GL) accounts for inventory valuation and cost of goods sold (COGS) posting. Drives financial accounting integration.

attributes.name: volume
attributes.description: Volumetric measurement of the material in cubic meters. Used for bulk materials (concrete, aggregates) and transportation capacity planning.

attributes.name: volume_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for volume field. Typically cubic meters (M3) for construction bulk materials.

attributes.name: weight_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for gross and net weight fields. Typically kilograms (KG) or metric tons (TON) for construction materials.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Width dimension of the material in meters. Used for area calculations and storage layout planning.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created the material master record. Supports audit trail and data stewardship accountability.

products.name: rfq
products.description: Request for Quotation records issued to vendors for pricing and availability of materials, equipment, or services, including header-level metadata and granular line-item detail. Captures RFQ number, issuing project, scope description, BOQ reference, submission deadline, bid bond requirement, evaluation criteria, invited vendor list, currency, RFQ status (draft, issued, closed, awarded, cancelled), and individual line items (line number, material/service description, quantity, UoM, required delivery date, site delivery location, technical specification reference, drawing/BIM reference). Sourced from SAP MM RFQ process and Procore bid management workflows. Enables granular vendor pricing comparison at the line-item level.

attributes.name: rfq_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Request for Quotation record. Primary key for the RFQ entity.

attributes.name: awarded_vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor to whom the contract or purchase order was awarded following RFQ evaluation. Null if RFQ is not yet awarded or was cancelled.

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.account. Business justification: RFQ is issued by a client account; linking enables audit of which client requested each quotation.

attributes.name: drawing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.drawing. Business justification: RFQ includes design drawing to define item scope; procurement uses drawing for accurate material specification.

attributes.name: firm_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to bid.firm_profile. Business justification: Awarded RFQs may be to firms; linking enables tracking of firm bids, performance, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: rfp_issuance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.rfp_issuance. Business justification: Construction procurement workflow: a client-issued RFP (rfp_issuance) directly triggers internal RFQs to vendors for cost buildup and scope pricing. Linking rfq to rfp_issuance enables bid cost tracea

attributes.name: staffing_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.staffing_plan. Business justification: RFQs for subcontracted labor services are driven by the project staffing plan. Linking RFQ to the originating staffing plan enables procurement-workforce alignment tracking, ensures RFQ scope matches

attributes.name: technical_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.technical_specification. Business justification: RFQ references technical specification that defines material requirements; linking ensures traceability from procurement to design spec.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.wbs_element. Business justification: RFQs in construction are issued for specific WBS scope packages. Linking RFQ to WBS element enables procurement budget utilization tracking, scope-to-procurement traceability, and supports the procure

attributes.name: award_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contract or purchase order was awarded to the selected vendor. Null if RFQ is not yet awarded.

attributes.name: awarded_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the contract or purchase order awarded to the winning vendor. Null if RFQ is not yet awarded.

attributes.name: bid_bond_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the bid bond required from vendors, if applicable. Typically a percentage of the estimated contract value.

attributes.name: bid_bond_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether vendors must submit a bid bond or financial guarantee with their quotation to demonstrate commitment and financial capacity.

attributes.name: boq_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the Bill of Quantities document or section that this RFQ is based on. Links the RFQ to the project cost estimation and material take-off data.

attributes.name: buyer_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the buyer or procurement contact for vendor inquiries and quotation submissions.

attributes.name: buyer_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the procurement professional or buyer responsible for managing this RFQ and serving as the primary point of contact for vendors.

attributes.name: buyer_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the buyer or procurement contact for urgent vendor communications.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the RFQ was cancelled or withdrawn, if applicable. May include project scope changes, budget constraints, or inadequate vendor response.

attributes.name: closed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the RFQ was officially closed, either through award, cancellation, or withdrawal. Marks the end of the vendor response period.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Type of contract structure anticipated for the awarded work: lump sum, unit price, cost plus fee, Guaranteed Maximum Price (GMP), or time and materials.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the RFQ record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which vendor quotations must be submitted (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures consistent pricing comparison.

attributes.name: delivery_location
attributes.description: Physical site address or location code where the materials or equipment must be delivered. May reference a specific construction site, warehouse, or laydown area.

attributes.name: evaluation_criteria

Records GR document number, delivery date, received quantity, unit of measure, storage location, batch number, delivery note reference, condition on receipt (accepted, rejected, partial), receiving inspector, and SAP material document number. Triggers inventory update and three-way match for invoice verification.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Primary key for goods_receipt

attributes.name: cost_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.cost_account. Business justification: Goods receipt postings record actual material costs against cost accounts in construction ERP. This FK enables the cost account's actual_cost_amount to be updated upon GR posting, supporting material

attributes.name: cost_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_code. Business justification: Construction goods receipts are coded to cost codes (CSI divisions) for job cost tracking and WBS-level material cost reporting. This FK enables cost-code-level material consumption analysis and budge

attributes.name: craft_worker_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.craft_worker. Business justification: Goods receipts require a named receiving inspector — in construction this is a craft worker (QC inspector or site foreman). Replacing denormalized 'receiving_inspector_name' with a FK enforces referen

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: GR postings in construction debit inventory/WIP GL accounts. This FK supports GL-level material cost posting audit, balance sheet inventory valuation, and financial close reconciliation. No existing F

attributes.name: material_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.material_catalog. Business justification: Link goods receipt material to master catalog for normalization and remove redundant material_id column.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order against which this goods receipt is recorded. Links the physical delivery to the procurement contract.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or vendor who delivered the materials. Used for supplier performance tracking and three-way match verification.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer batch or lot number for the received materials. Critical for traceability, quality control, and recall management.

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Name of the transportation carrier or logistics provider who delivered the materials. Used for carrier performance tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the goods receipt value (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Used for multi-currency financial reporting.

attributes.name: delivery_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this goods receipt completes the delivery for the purchase order line item (True=complete, False=partial delivery expected).

attributes.name: delivery_note_number
attributes.description: External delivery note or packing slip number provided by the vendor. Used for cross-referencing vendor shipment documentation.

attributes.name: gr_document_number
attributes.description: Unique business document number assigned to this goods receipt transaction. Used for audit trail and cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: inspection_status
attributes.description: Quality inspection status for the received materials. Determines whether materials can be released to inventory or must remain in quarantine.

attributes.name: invoice_verification_status
attributes.description: Status of three-way match process comparing PO, goods receipt, and vendor invoice. Determines whether invoice can be paid.

attributes.name: material_document_number
attributes.description: SAP material document number generated upon goods receipt posting. Used for inventory movement tracking and financial integration.

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: SAP movement type code indicating the type of inventory transaction (e.g., 101=GR for PO, 122=Return Delivery). Determines financial and inventory impact.

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material originally ordered on the purchase order line item. Used for variance analysis against received quantity.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Financial posting date for the goods receipt transaction. Used for period-end closing and financial reporting alignment.

attributes.name: receipt_condition
attributes.description: Condition status of the received materials upon inspection (accepted=fully accepted, rejected=fully rejected, partial=partially accepted, damaged=damaged on arrival, on_hold=pending inspection, quarantine=quality hold).

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: Date on which the materials were physically received at the site or warehouse. Used for lead time analysis and schedule compliance tracking.

attributes.name: receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the goods receipt was recorded in the system. Used for audit trail and real-time inventory updates.

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity of material physically received and accepted. This is the quantity that updates inventory and triggers invoice verification.

attributes.name: rejected_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material rejected due to quality issues, damage, or non-conformance. Triggers vendor return or credit memo process.

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the reversal transaction if this goods receipt was cancelled. Used for audit trail and reconciliation.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this goods receipt has been reversed or cancelled (True=reversed, False=active). Reversed receipts do not update inventory.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description explaining why the goods receipt was reversed (e.g., incorrect posting, return to vendor, data entry error).

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number for serialized equipment or high-value items. Enables individual asset tracking and warranty management.

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Any special handling requirements or instructions for the received materials (e.g., temperature control, hazardous material protocols, fragile handling).
attributes.references: OSHA Occupational Safety and Health Administration

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific storage location, warehouse bin, or laydown area where the materials are stored after receipt.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction code applied to the goods receipt for sales tax, VAT, or GST calculation. Determines tax treatment in financial posting.

attributes.name: total_value
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the goods receipt (received quantity × unit price). Updates inventory value and triggers accounts payable accrual.

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Shipment tracking number provided by the carrier. Enables real-time delivery status monitoring and proof of delivery.

attributes.name: transportation_mode
attributes.description: Method of transportation used to deliver the materials (truck, rail, air, sea, courier, pickup). Used for logistics analysis and lead time optimization.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the received quantity (e.g., EA=Each, M=Meter, M2=Square Meter, M3=Cubic Meter, KG=Kilogram, TON=Ton, L=Liter). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|M|M2|M3|KG|TON|L|BOX|PALLET|SET — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Price per unit of measure for the received material as per the purchase order. Used for inventory valuation and three-way match with invoice.

attributes.name: unloading_point
attributes.description: Specific unloading dock, gate, or receiving area where the materials were delivered at the construction site.

attributes.name: valuation_type
attributes.description: Material valuation category used for inventory accounting (e.g., standard cost, moving average price). Determines how the receipt is valued financially.

attributes.name: variance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes explaining any discrepancies, damages, or special conditions observed during goods receipt. Used for dispute resolution and vendor performance tracking.

attributes.name: variance_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for any variance between ordered and received quantities (e.g., short shipment, over delivery, damaged goods).

Distinct from client billing invoices owned by the finance domain — this is the SSOT for vendor payable documents in procurement.

attributes.name: gl_account_id

attributes.name: project_change_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_change_order. attributes.name: vendor_id

attributes.name: approval_date

attributes.name: blocked_reason

attributes.name: invoice_date

attributes.name: invoice_description

attributes.name: invoice_gross_amount

attributes.name: invoice_net_amount

attributes.name: invoice_type

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|credit_memo|debit_memo|prepayment|final|progress|retention_release — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments related to this invoice, such as special instructions, clarifications, or internal remarks.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which payment was made to the vendor for this invoice.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment must be made to the vendor to comply with payment terms and avoid late payment penalties.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The method by which payment will be made to the vendor for this invoice.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the payment transaction when the invoice is paid, linking the invoice to the payment record.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: The agreed payment terms for this invoice, such as Net 30, Net 60, or 2/10 Net 30, defining the payment schedule and any early payment discount conditions.

attributes.name: retention_amount
attributes.description: Amount withheld from the invoice payment as retention per contract terms, typically released upon project completion or after the Defects Liability Period (DLP).

attributes.name: retention_percentage

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applied to the invoice, including sales tax, VAT, GST, or other applicable taxes.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax code applied to this invoice, defining the tax rate and tax type (VAT, GST, sales tax) per jurisdiction.

attributes.name: three_way_match_status
attributes.description: Result of the three-way match validation comparing purchase order, goods receipt (GR), and invoice. Indicates whether quantities, prices, and terms align across all three documents.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of the invoice verification process indicating whether the invoice has been validated against the purchase order and goods receipt.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount

products.name: approved_vendor_list_item
products.description: This association product represents the sourcing agreement between a vendor and a material in the procurement catalog. It captures vendor-specific pricing, lead times, and sourcing terms for each vendor-material combination. Each record links one vendor to one material with attributes that exist only in the context of this sourcing relationship. Known in SAP MM as Info Record or Source List entry.. Existence Justification: In construction procurement, materials are routinely sourced from multiple approved vendors to enable competitive bidding, manage supply chain risk, and optimize for price/lead time trade-offs. Each vendor-material combination has its own pricing, lead time, minimum order quantity, and validity period. This is the Approved Vendor List (AVL) or Info Record concept in SAP MM, actively managed by procurement teams for sourcing decisions.

attributes.name: vendor_unit_price

domains.name: equipment
domains.description: Construction equipment and fleet management domain tracking heavy machinery (cranes, excavators, concrete pumps), tools, generators, and fleet vehicles. Owns asset master data, utilization tracking, maintenance schedules, equipment hours, mobilization/demobilization records, rental vs. owned classification, and asset lifecycle management via SAP PM and HCSS HeavyJob.

products.name: asset
products.description: Core master record for every piece of construction equipment and fleet vehicle owned, long-term leased, or rented by the company. Captures asset identity, classification (crane, excavator, concrete pump, generator, fleet vehicle, small tool), make, model, serial number, year of manufacture, acquisition date, acquisition cost, ownership type (owned/rented/leased), current status (active, idle, under maintenance, disposed), SAP PM equipment number, HCSS HeavyJob asset ID, regulatory compliance class, and asset lifecycle stage. For disposed assets: captures disposal method (sale, auction, scrap, write-off, trade-in), disposal date, disposal proceeds, buyer details, reason for disposal, and authorizing approver. This is the SSOT for all equipment identity and lifecycle data across the enterprise, from commissioning through disposal.
products.reference: SAP PM Equipment Master / HCSS HeavyJob Asset Register

products.name: hours
products.description: Daily or shift-level transactional record of equipment operating hours, idle hours, standby hours, and downtime events captured from HCSS HeavyJob field time tracking. Includes cost code, operator ID, project and WBS reference, fuel consumption, meter reading (odometer or hour meter), shift date, production quantity achieved. For non-productive time: captures downtime start/end timestamps, duration, downtime category (breakdown, awaiting parts, awaiting operator, weather hold, scheduled maintenance), root cause code, resolution action, and impact assessment. Foundational for equipment utilization rate calculation, cost-per-hour analysis, MTTR (Mean Time To Repair), MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures), availability rate reporting, and CPI/SPI reporting under EVM. SSOT for all equipment time and downtime recording. Primary source: HCSS HeavyJob daily time entry.

products.name: inspection_record
products.description: Transactional record of a statutory, regulatory, or internal safety inspection performed on a piece of equipment, and the master register of all resulting compliance certificates issued. Captures inspection type (pre-start check, periodic statutory inspection, OSHA compliance check, crane load test, lifting gear inspection, pressure vessel test, FAT/SAT), inspection date, inspector name and certification, pass/fail outcome, defects identified, corrective actions required, next inspection due date. For certificates: captures certificate type (crane load test certificate, pressure vessel certificate, lifting gear certificate, OSHA compliance certificate, insurance certificate), certificate number, issuing authority, issue date, expiry date, and document storage reference. SSOT for all equipment inspection events AND asset-level compliance certificates. Supports OSHA compliance, insurance requirements, equipment fitness-for-use certification, pre-mobilization compliance checks, and regulatory audit trails. Distinct from quality ITP inspections (owned by quality domain) and operator certifications (which track people, not assets).

attributes.name: dispatch_condition
attributes.description: Assessed physical and operational condition of the equipment at the time of dispatch from the origin location.

attributes.name: dispatch_condition_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes or observations regarding the equipment condition at dispatch, including any pre-existing damage or defects.

attributes.name: dispatch_signature_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the dispatch sign-off was completed.

attributes.name: distance_km
attributes.description: Total distance in kilometers between the origin and destination locations.

attributes.name: estimated_transit_hours
attributes.description: Estimated duration in hours for the equipment to be transported from origin to destination.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Type of equipment movement event: mobilization (to site), demobilization (from site), inter-site transfer, or relocation.

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the equipment is covered by insurance during the mobilization transport.

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number of the insurance coverage applicable to this mobilization event.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the mobilization record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: mobilization_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the mobilization event, typically formatted as MOB-YYYYNNNN.

attributes.name: mobilization_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the mobilization event in the workflow.

attributes.name: origin_location
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the location from which the equipment is being mobilized (yard, warehouse, previous site).

attributes.name: origin_site_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the origin site or facility.

attributes.name: permit_number
attributes.description: Official permit number(s) issued by the governing authority for this transport.

attributes.name: permit_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether special permits (oversize load, road permits, environmental permits) are required for this mobilization.

attributes.name: permit_type
attributes.description: Type of permit(s) required for the transport, such as oversize load permit, road use permit, or environmental permit. Multiple permits may be listed.

attributes.name: planned_arrival_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date when the equipment is expected to arrive at the destination location.

attributes.name: planned_dispatch_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date when the equipment is planned to depart from the origin location.

attributes.name: reason
attributes.description: Business justification or reason for the mobilization event, such as project start, equipment replacement, or maintenance requirement.

attributes.name: receipt_condition
attributes.description: Assessed physical and operational condition of the equipment upon receipt at the destination location.

attributes.name: receipt_condition_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes or observations regarding the equipment condition at receipt, including any damage incurred during transport.

attributes.name: receipt_signature_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the receipt sign-off was completed.

attributes.name: receipt_signed_by
attributes.description: Name of the site manager or authorized personnel who signed off on the equipment receipt at the destination.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Additional comments, notes, or special instructions related to the mobilization event.

attributes.name: transport_cost
attributes.description: Total cost incurred for transporting the equipment, including freight, permits, and handling charges.

attributes.name: transport_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transport cost.

attributes.name: transport_method
attributes.description: Method or mode of transportation used to move the equipment.

products.name: fuel_transaction
products.description: Transactional record of fuel issued to a piece of equipment or fleet vehicle. Captures fuel type (diesel, petrol, LPG), quantity issued (litres), unit cost, total cost, issuing fuel point or bowser, date and time of issue, hour meter or odometer reading at fueling, project and cost code allocation, and operator confirmation. Enables fuel consumption tracking, cost-per-hour analysis, carbon emissions reporting (ISO 14001), and detection of fuel wastage or theft.
products.reference: HCSS HeavyJob Fuel Entry / SAP MM Goods Issue

attributes.name: fuel_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fuel transaction record. Primary key.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Fuel supply is frequently contracted; associating each transaction with the governing agreement enables expense allocation and audit.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the equipment or fleet vehicle that received fuel. Links to the equipment master data.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the construction project to which this fuel transaction is allocated for cost tracking.

attributes.name: finance_cost_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_code. Business justification: Fuel consumption is charged to a cost code for cost allocation and EVM reporting.

attributes.name: firm_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to bid.firm_profile. Business justification: Fuel transactions for equipment used by Firm are billed to that Firm, needed for cost recovery and fuel consumption reporting.

attributes.name: fleet_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to equipment.fleet_assignment. Business justification: Fuel consumption occurs within the context of a specific fleet assignment (equipment assigned to a project/work front for a period). Linking fuel_transaction.fleet_assignment_id → fleet_assignment.fle

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.invoice. Business justification: Bulk fuel purchases and fuel card transactions generate AP invoices from fuel vendors. fuel_transaction.invoice_number is a denormalized reference to finance.invoice. Linking enables AP reconciliation

attributes.name: operator_craft_worker_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.craft_worker. Business justification: fuel_transaction.operator_name is a denormalized text field. Linking to craft_worker enables fuel cost allocation by operator, theft investigation accountability, and operator fuel consumption reporti

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Fuel procurement reconciliation: bulk fuel supply in construction is managed via purchase orders to fuel vendors. Linking fuel transactions to their backing PO enables 3-way match for fuel invoices, P

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the external fuel vendor or supplier if fuel was purchased from a third-party station. Null for internal fuel depots.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the WBS element for detailed project cost allocation and tracking.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval status of the fuel transaction. Indicates whether the transaction has been reviewed and approved by a supervisor or cost controller.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fuel transaction was approved. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person who approved the fuel transaction. Null if auto-approved or pending approval.

attributes.name: carbon_emission_kg
attributes.description: Estimated carbon dioxide emissions in kilograms resulting from the fuel consumed. Calculated based on fuel type and quantity for ISO 14001 environmental reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fuel transaction record was first created in the system. Represents the audit trail creation time.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction cost (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: fuel_card_number
attributes.description: Fuel card or fleet card number used for the transaction. Masked or tokenized for security. Used for reconciliation with vendor invoices.

attributes.name: fuel_point_name
attributes.description: Name or description of the fuel point or bowser where the fuel was issued.

attributes.name: hour_meter_reading
attributes.description: Hour meter reading of the equipment at the time of fueling. Used to calculate fuel consumption per operating hour and detect anomalies.

attributes.name: is_emergency_refuel
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this was an emergency or unplanned refueling event. True indicates emergency; False indicates scheduled refueling.

attributes.name: is_theft_suspected
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether fuel theft or wastage is suspected based on consumption patterns or anomaly detection. True indicates suspected theft; False indicates normal transaction.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fuel transaction record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: odometer_reading
attributes.description: Odometer reading of the fleet vehicle at the time of fueling. Used for mileage-based fuel consumption analysis. Applicable to vehicles with odometers.

attributes.name: quantity_issued
attributes.description: Quantity of fuel issued to the equipment in the specified unit of measure. Typically measured in litres or gallons.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the fuel transaction in the source system. Used for traceability and reconciliation.

attributes.name: tank_capacity_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the equipment fuel tank capacity filled during this transaction. Used to detect partial fills and optimize refueling schedules.

attributes.name: total_cost
attributes.description: Total cost of the fuel transaction calculated as quantity issued multiplied by unit cost. Expressed in the transaction currency.

attributes.name: transaction_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the fuel transaction. May include reasons for emergency refueling, discrepancies, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique transaction number or receipt number issued at the time of fueling. Used for audit trail and reconciliation.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current status of the fuel transaction in its lifecycle. Completed indicates finalized and posted; pending indicates awaiting approval; cancelled indicates voided; disputed indicates under review.

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fuel was issued to the equipment. Represents the actual business event time of fueling.

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Cost per unit of fuel at the time of transaction. Expressed in the transaction currency.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the fuel quantity issued. Common units include litres, gallons, or kWh for electric charging.

products.name: operator_certification
products.description: Master record of an equipment operator's certification, licence, or competency qualification for a specific equipment type or class. Captures operator reference (linked to workforce domain), equipment category certified for (e.g., tower crane, mobile crane, excavator, forklift), certifying body, certificate number, issue date, expiry date, certification status (valid, expired, suspended), and renewal requirements. Supports OSHA compliance, HSE pre-start checks, and operator-to-equipment assignment validation. Owned by equipment domain as it governs equipment operation rights.
products.reference: OSHA Operator Certification / Crane Operator Licence

attributes.name: operator_certification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the operator certification record. Primary key for the operator certification entity.

attributes.name: asset_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to equipment.asset_category. Business justification: Operator certification is tied to an equipment category; replace free‑text category with FK to asset_category to enforce consistency.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: add column construction_project_id (BIGINT) with FK to project.construction_project.construction_project_id - operator certifications are verified per project for site access compliance

attributes.name: craft_worker_id
attributes.description: Reference to the equipment operator in the workforce domain who holds this certification. Links to the workforce master data to identify the individual operator.

attributes.name: document_register_id
attributes.description: Reference to the digital document or scanned copy of the physical certification document stored in the document management system. Links to Aconex or BIM 360 document repository.

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the operator completed the certification assessment or examination. Represents the formal evaluation event.

attributes.name: assessor_name
attributes.description: Name of the qualified assessor or examiner who conducted the certification assessment and validated the operators competency.

attributes.name: capacity_rating
attributes.description: The maximum capacity or tonnage rating of equipment the operator is certified to operate, such as cranes up to 100 tons or forklifts up to 5 tons. Defines operational limits for equipment assignment.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique certificate or license number issued by the certifying body. This is the externally-known identifier for the certification document.

attributes.name: certification_level
attributes.description: The proficiency or skill level represented by the certification, such as basic, intermediate, advanced, or master operator. Indicates the complexity of equipment and operations the operator is qualified to perform. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: basic|intermediate|advanced|master|trainee|journeyman|supervisor — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the certification. Indicates whether the certification is valid and active, expired, suspended, revoked, or pending renewal. Critical for HSE pre-start checks and operator assignment validation.

attributes.name: certification_type
attributes.description: The type or nature of the certification, such as operator license, competency card, safety certification, or manufacturer-specific certification.

attributes.name: certifying_body
attributes.description: Name of the organization, authority, or institution that issued the certification. Examples include NCCCO, OSHA-approved training providers, manufacturer training centers, or government licensing authorities.

attributes.name: certifying_body_accreditation_number
attributes.description: Accreditation or registration number of the certifying body, validating that the issuing organization is authorized to provide certifications.

attributes.name: cost_amount
attributes.description: The total cost incurred to obtain or renew this certification, including training fees, examination fees, and administrative charges. Used for workforce development cost tracking.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the certification cost amount. Enables multi-currency cost tracking for international operations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this certification record was first created in the system. Follows ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: endorsements
attributes.description: Additional endorsements, specializations, or restrictions associated with the certification, such as night operations, confined spaces, or specific attachment types. Comma-separated list of endorsement codes or descriptions.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification expires and is no longer valid. Operators must renew or recertify before this date to maintain valid certification status.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification was originally issued to the operator. Represents the start of the certification validity period.

attributes.name: issuing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the country in which the certification was issued. Important for cross-border projects and international operator mobility.

attributes.name: issuing_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or regional jurisdiction within the issuing country where the certification was granted. Relevant for jurisdictions with state-level licensing requirements.

attributes.name: last_renewal_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which the certification was renewed or recertified. Tracks the certification maintenance history.

attributes.name: medical_clearance_date
attributes.description: The date on which the operator received medical clearance or passed the required health examination for this certification. Nullable if medical clearance is not required.

attributes.name: medical_clearance_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the medical clearance expires and must be renewed. Nullable if medical clearance is not required or does not expire.

attributes.name: medical_clearance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a medical examination or health clearance is required as part of the certification or renewal process. True if medical clearance is mandatory, false otherwise.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who last modified this certification record. Provides audit trail for data changes.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this certification record was last modified in the system. Follows ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: next_renewal_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the operator must complete renewal requirements to maintain continuous certification. Used for proactive renewal planning and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special conditions related to the certification. Captures contextual information not covered by structured fields.

attributes.name: practical_assessment_score
attributes.description: Score or grade achieved by the operator in the practical hands-on assessment component of the certification. Typically expressed as a percentage or numeric score.

attributes.name: reciprocity_agreements
attributes.description: List of countries, states, or jurisdictions where this certification is recognized under reciprocity or mutual recognition agreements. Enables cross-jurisdictional operator deployment.
attributes.references: FIDIC International Federation of Consulting Engineers

attributes.name: renewal_requirement
attributes.description: Description of the requirements the operator must fulfill to renew the certification, such as refresher training hours, re-assessment, continuing education credits, or medical examination.

attributes.name: restrictions
attributes.description: Any limitations or restrictions placed on the certification, such as daylight operations only, supervised operation required, or specific site conditions. Defines operational boundaries for the operator.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this certification record in the source operational system. Enables traceability and reconciliation with source systems.

attributes.name: sponsor_organization
attributes.description: Name of the organization that sponsored or paid for the operators certification training and examination. May be the construction company, a subcontractor, or the operator themselves.

attributes.name: theory_assessment_score
attributes.description: Score or grade achieved by the operator in the theoretical or written examination component of the certification. Typically expressed as a percentage or numeric score.

attributes.name: training_hours_completed
attributes.description: Total number of training hours completed by the operator to achieve this certification. Demonstrates the depth of training and preparation.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification was last verified with the certifying body or through an independent verification process.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of the certification verification process, indicating whether the certification has been independently verified with the issuing body. Critical for compliance and audit purposes.

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person, system, or organization that performed the certification verification. Provides audit trail for verification activities.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who created this certification record in the system. Provides audit trail for data entry.

domains.name: workforce
domains.description: Construction workforce management domain tracking labor resources, crew assignments, time tracking, production rates, skill certifications, labor cost coding, field personnel deployment, and site access records. Manages craft labor, supervision, and project-based staffing distinct from corporate HR functions. Integrates with HCSS HeavyJob for timesheets and SAP SuccessFactors for HCM.

products.name: craft_worker
products.description: Master record for all craft labor personnel deployed on construction projects including hourly trade workers and working foremen/supervisors. Captures worker identity, trade classification (from skill_trade taxonomy), employment type (direct hire, agency, union referral), union affiliation and local, craft code, supervisory role flag, home project assignment, mobilization status, security clearance level, and field deployment history. SSOT for individual field worker identity in the workforce domain. Workers may hold multiple trade classifications and rotate between craft and supervisory roles across projects. Integrates with SAP SuccessFactors for HCM master data and HCSS HeavyJob for field time tracking.

attributes.name: craft_worker_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the craft worker record. Primary key for the craft worker entity.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary construction project to which the craft worker is currently assigned as their home base.

attributes.name: firm_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to bid.firm_profile. Business justification: Employer assignment: linking each craft worker to the firm firm that employs them, required for labor cost allocation and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: labor_cost_code_id
